189000.description:
Nao is a first-year university student who is enjoying her campus life in a quiet and fun way. Everyone on campus is talking about her classmate, a handsome model named "Shou", but people in the glamorous world shouldn't have anything to do with a plain girl like me. Or so I thought, but it turns out that her childhood friend who is a crybaby and clumsy is "Shou"!? What's more, they suddenly start living together in secret...?

The love between the two who can't be honest with each other starts to move after they meet again.

(Source: Mecha Comic, translated)

title.native: 再会した幼馴染が私を好きだなんて聞いてない!
title.romaji: Saikai Shita Osananajimi ga Watashi o Sukida Nante Kii Tenai!

189001.description:
Since childhood, Yukiya has been able to see things that are not human. Now a university student, he joins his friends in attending the Occult Research Club, where they accidentally summon a demon named Fred. To protect his clubmates, Yukiya ends up making a contract with him…!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 惑う羊は手のひらの上
title.romaji: Madou Hitsuji wa Tenohira no Ue

189002.description:
One day, high school girl Kamishiro Tsumugi suddenly becomes a boy...?! A new everyday life begins with her female childhood friend and the boys in her class.

This is a different story, set in the same world as Zenbu Kimi no Sei.

title.native: 男の子になっちゃった女子高生

189003.description:
"Your smell, it's sweet. It's arousing...!"
The body reacts as his neck and nipples are licked. Then his boner is grabbed... he wants to escape, but he can't...?

Akito, who had always been loved by animals since childhood for some reason, had his boss's friend, Oguma (a man who's big like a bear), also attached to him. Oguma, who's sensitive to smells, would always sniff Akito, saying that he smells good... One day, while getting his scent sniffed, Akito accidentally lets out a moan. Hearing that, Oguma's reacts... "I want to cum now, so I'll make you feel good while I'm at it."

...Excuse me!? He's sniffing my neck, licking it, and touching my nipples... rubbing our hard dicks together... What's going on?? It's amazing...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

189004.description:
High schooler Kota reunites with his childhood friend, Naoto, after six years. When they were kids, they were always together. Kota, being a bit rambunctious, would always drag around the quiet and meek Naoto, getting him caught up in his antics. There was one time, however, when Naoto went against him. After that, Naoto moved away without saying a word. Since then, Kota has regretted bullying Naoto when they were kids. When they saw each other again, Naoto talked to Kota like nothing happened. Kota blurts out an apology and says to make up for things he'll grant Naoto one wish. But Naoto wishes for him and Kota to become lovers?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 僕のかわいいいじめっこ

189005.description:
"I want to do anything for Koharu if that's what he desires."
Soon after transferring to a new school, Koharu is pushed down by the carefree and loyal-to-his-instincts senior, Oosugi. Before he knows it, the two of them are in a romantic relationship. Their overly affectionate, lovey-dovey behavior is well-known around school and continues to progress. However, things take a turn when Oosugi's friend, Shigihara, and Koharu's classmate, Yatsudo, get involved, sparking a love square battle! Meanwhile, Osugi's feelings for Koharu only grow stronger with each passing day...!?

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

189006.description:
Glico-Morinaga, Sada Abe, the Three Billion Yen Robbery, the Yodo Plane Hijacking, the Slit-Mouth Woman... These are the famous, almost too famous, bizarre incidents that colored the Showa era. This unprecedented comic crime file delves into the "localized" details of these events!

Set in the editorial department of a weekly magazine, a rookie male reporter and his senior female reporter team up to uncover the sepia-toned "truth" behind bizarre incidents from the Showa era.

Starting with the "New Era Name False Report Incident" on December 25, 1926 (Showa 1), the story covers pre-war bizarre crimes like "Sada Abe" and the "Tsuyama 30 Murders," difficult cases from the occupation period such as "Teigin" and "Shimoyama," unsolved cases like the "Three Billion Yen Robbery" and "Glico-Morinaga," and even strange incidents like the "Slit-Mouth Woman" and "Erimaki Tokage." This series provides a comprehensive look at the strange, bizarre, and unsolved incidents that occurred throughout the Showa era's 64 years, exploring the graffiti of Showa history through rare, strange, and mysterious cases!

(Source: Bungei Shunjuu, translated)

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 経済立国編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Keizai Rikkoku-hen

189008.description:
"I can't believe the talented hands that make me such amazing food are really brushing across my lips..."

Office worker Miki is nearly 30, but her small stature makes her seem much younger, which scares off all but the creepiest of guys... With that on her plate on top of the stress of work, Miki keeps her spirits up with a weekly "treat": dinner and drinks at a local bar run by the handsome Chef Kayaba. Just a glimpse of his sinewy arms as he works has Miki daydreaming about what his hands would feel like running over her body, but she's content just to watch...until one day she gets a chance to drink alone with him after the bar closes and all of a sudden things are moving fast!! Yet, for some secret reason, he says he can't make love to her...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: おいしい恋をください

189009.description:
The bane of my existence? This body of mine that curses men into becoming obsessed with me... But all I have ever dreamed of is finding true love! Having grown up on fairy tales, I've always been a sucker for the kind Prince Charming type. But it seems I'm not destined for the happy ever after of my dreams. Apparently, I have what some guys call a "legendary snatch" and every man I have dated so far has turned into nothing more than a lecherous zombie! And just when I was sure there was no hope... I met Suzui. He seemed different from others, made me feel safe with his kindness and that hint of sadness behind his eyes. And I'd soon find out that he had his own secrets he's keeping...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: What's Wrong With Dreaming About Love?
title.native: ロマンティックを夢見て何が悪い
title.romaji: Romantic wo Yumemite Nani ga Warui

189010.description:
This story is about a young girl, Yuri, who was born into a prestigious flower arranging family, the Misono family. In order to pay of the debt her mother left, Yuri is made to marry Tsubaki, her first crush. Yuri, having admired Tsubaki from a far for ten years, is actually bewildered by the decision, To complicate matters, the dignified and beautiful Tsubaki is cold and won't even make eye contact with Yuri. On their wedding night, though, he kisses her sweetly as if deeply in love and ravishes her until she loses consciousness...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Petals of Destiny: Political Marriage with a Handsome Flower Arranger
title.native: イケメン華道家と政略結婚したら、意識がトぶまで愛でられました
title.romaji: Ikemen Kadouka to Seiryaku Kekkon Shitara, Ishiki ga Tobuma de Mederaremashita

189011.description:
Having spent junior high being all alone, Yuka is determined to act nice and fit in at high school. Until one day, when she gets into trouble with another girl, until a classmate, Koki, steps in and break up the argument. But he scolds Yuka, too, giving her the impression of being a jerk at first!!

But now she can't take her eyes off him, even after they become good friends!
I'm not going hide my feelings this time. Straightforward adolescent love!

(Source: Nakayosi, translated)

Note: Originally published in Nakayosi 2025 Jan. issue.

189012.description:
Qiu Qian, a brilliant cultivator, failed in his ascension and space-traveled into a fantasy world of witchers. Out of curiosity, he decides to become a witcher and exterminate the monsters. His immense power attracts the attention of numerous females of this alternate realm, including she-elves, sorceresses, and dancers, all of whom wish to become his companions...

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: My Ascension Had Failed, so I Had to Become a Demon Hunter
My Ascension Had Failed, So I Had to Become a Witcher
修仙の天才、最強ハンターを目指す

title.english: Failed to Ascend, So I Became a Witcher Instead
title.native: 飞升失败，只好做猎魔人了
title.romaji: Feisheng Shibai, Zhihao Zuo Lie Mo Renle

189013.description:
Mika (a fudanshi in his previous life) is reborn into the world of a BL novel as a pathetic villain fated for certain death by execution. In order to avoid death, Mika decides to act as a mother-figure for his childhood friend Charles, the main character of the novel, to make sure he becomes a pure and innocent virgin boy. Thanks to his hard work, Charles grows up in a peaceful and healthy environment, but…

“Baka Mika… one day I'm going to fuck you up.”

Uh… what? Where did I go wrong?

(Source: Gene Pixiv, translated)

title.native: 悪役令息に転生したけど幼馴染のママ♂になるぞ！
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reisoku ni Tensei Shitakedo Osananajimi no Mama ♂ ni Naruzo!

189014.description:
Xu Qian found himself in a fantastical realm where he could form contracts with spirit beasts. With the title of "corrector," he awoke a special system and bonded with his initial spirit beast, one of space-time essence. Understanding the duties tied to being a "corrector," Xu Qian embarked on a mission to thwart interdimensional threats, utilizing the system to resolve conflicts and empower both the system itself and his growing array of spirit beasts.

(Source: INKR)

189015.description:
Nakamura-san, who sits next to me in class, is a gal with long nails, a smartphone, and a penchant for fashion. But I'm the only one who knows her secret identity. Nakamura-san is a gal-hero who protects the world!

(Source: Dengeki Daioh G, translated)

Note: Originally published in Dengeki Daioh G vol. 125.

189016.description:
As the screams of cicadas pierce the suffocating summer heat... Nanase finds himself cornered by a strange, sinister animal.

The only thing more depressing than Nanase's new cleaning job is his creepy, dead-eyed coworker, Kurono. And now that Kurono has turned that unnerving stare on Nanase, escape seems impossible. No matter what violence or vitriol Nanase hurls at him, Kurono refuses to tear his gaze away—and those vacant eyes see right through the jagged cracks in Nanase's bruised and battered heart. When violence is the veil through which you see the world, vulnerability is the enemy... but in Nanase's case, letting Kurono in may be the only way out.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.native: そんな激情で殴られたい

189017.description:
Luke has devised a plan to sleep with his childhood friend, but will he succeed?

(Source: Lalatoon)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

189018.description: Souji Mitsuka is an ordinary high school boy who has an obsession for twintails. One day he encounters a mysterious girl named Twoearle, who is from a parallel world, when monsters appear in his town and declare that all twintails in the world belong to them. These monsters feed off "attribute strength," the spiritual energy of humans. Twoearle entrusted Souji with Tail Gear, imaginary armor initiated by powerful twintail attributes. With the armor, Souji transforms into a girl and twintail warrior branded Tail Red, to protect Earth.

title.native: 俺、ツインテールになります。π

189019.description:
A descendant of a mermaid, Amami Riza, has obtained a jewel that holds the power of a mermaid. On the day she transformed into a mermaid for the first time, her classmate Kanda Ruka found her and asked her for mermaid tears, which are said to cure anything. In fact, Ruka was under a curse...

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

title.native: 僕は人魚姫を食べたい
title.romaji: Boku wa Ningyo Hime wo Tabetai

189020.description:
While enjoying the beautiful landscape of Venice, Sally is attacked by a man and rescued by Damiano, the owner of the hotel where she is staying. She receives an offer to stay at his mansion, where Sally discovers a different side to him and is charmed. On the day of the Carnival, she is thrilled when Damiano suddenly proposes to her. But for him, it is nothing more than a marriage of convenience.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.native: 仮面舞踏会の夜に愛して
title.romaji: Kamen Butoukai no Yoru ni Aishite

synonyms: I'm Sorry, I Can't Come to the Phone Right Now

title.native: ただいま電話に出ることができません
title.romaji: Tadaima Denwa ni Derukoto ga Dekimasen

189023.description:
"I can't have kids. It's impossible for me because I don't want to be a mother."

Asa and Tetsuya Kanazawa are "DINKs." A married couple that both work and make the conscious choice to never have children. Even after 3 years of marriage, that hasn't changed. One day, Asa is invited to her high school class reunion. Not only is she unable to join in her former classmates' conversation as they talk about raising kids, but she also overhears them talking about her being childless behind her back, making the whole night extremely uncomfortable for Asa. After getting home, a depressed Asa is comforted by Tetsu's words, "We don't have to have kids." But behind those words Tetsu harbors secret feelings and Asa has no way to know...!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Ten Months of DINKs ~Is It Wrong Not to Have Kids?~
title.native: DINKsのトツキトオカ 「産まない女」はダメですか？
title.romaji: DINKs no Totsukitoka "Umanai Onna " wa Damedesu ka？

title.native: 刺激の向こう -アフターピル-
されるがままじゃいられない!!
愛追うふたり　そのあと
