1-4. Tooku ni Arite... (遠くにありて…)
5. Fuyu no Mizutori (冬の水鳥)
6. Nishi no Tsuki (西の月)
7. Kikyou　―Aru Heishi no Kyujitsu― (帰郷 ―ある兵士の休日―)
8. Aru Yoru no Dekigoto (ある夜の出来事)
9. Watashi no Debut Jidai (わたしのデビュー時代)

189030.description: Special prize winner of the Fall 2011 Afternoon Four Seasons Award.

189031.description: Grand prize winner of the Spring 2012 Afternoon Four Seasons Award.

189032.description:
In 1946, a young man named Ryo lost his right hand and right leg in the war. After the war, he returned to his family home in Kyoto, but unable to do anything with only half his body and unable to protect his sister, he despaired of finding meaning in life. However, at a certain shrine, he hears a mysterious voice...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

189033.description: Notes: Also includes Kiseki no Hanashi (奇跡の話) and Charisma Gari (カリスマ狩り)

189034.description:
Buildings all over the world have suddenly become monster-filled Dungeons. Every nation summons its full military might to fight this disaster, only to fail miserably. But when everything seems lost, the Awakeners appear! Armed with Gate Cards, the Awakeners destroy these dungeons and rise to fame and wealth. Wanting a better life for his family, Hanbit Park aspires to become an Awakener. But he'll soon realize that there are more than monsters out in the world...

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.native: 俺のターンは終わらない

189035.description: Note: Published in Web Haishin Gekkan Tonari no Kininaru Oku-san Vol. 092
synonyms: Gyaru Tsuma-chan wa Kyou mo Tarinai

title.native: ギャル妻ちゃんは今日も足りない
title.romaji: Gal Tsuma-chan wa Kyou mo Tarinai

189037.description:
A boy who receives unwanted confessions all the time gets beat up when he refuses! When she tries to help him out, he turns out to be a guy with a few quirks of his own…?

(Source: Margaret, translated)

Note: Originally published in Margaret 2024 vol. 21

189038.description:
In a village full of nature’s blessings, there were three childhood friends. Tiny, the hunter’s child. Thor, the village chief’s child. Sorier, the merchant’s child. They were all very close and always laughing together.

...Until they gained their gender. In this world, people gain their gender at the age of 10 and start becoming adults. Seeing Thor, who became a "boy," and Sorier, who became a "girl," Tiny begins to feel uneasy about the closeness between them.
"I see, I’ve always... liked Thor." Then, on his 10th birthday, the gender the gods gave Tiny was... "boy." Realizing he is now a "boy," Tiny suppresses his feelings for Thor and distances himself from the two. At 18, after his feelings for Thor have settled, Tiny reunites with him. The feelings of "love" he had long suppressed, the responsibility of living as a "man"...

The inner conflict born from gaining a gender later in life, and the future of their feelings.

(Source: Pulpride, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

189039.description:
Yoji Akutagawa is an exceptional doctor. However, due to his lack of people skills, he's been relegated to handling surgeries only. At home, his nephew Kento recently told him he wants to move out and attend a boarding school once he graduates junior high. Then, at a meeting with Kento's tutor Mr. Yagi, Kento continues to complain about how fed up he is living with a barely-present uncle who always acts apathetic towards everything outside of his work. While Yoji is still reeling from shock, Mr. Yagi begins to take a deeper interest in Yoji and Kento's issues.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: Dr. Useless And His Unexpressed Affection
title.native: Dr.ポンコツのつたわらない愛情

189040.description:
What happens when you finally hit 100% for a character’s route in an otome game? You’d marry him, right? Wrong! Joo-ah isn’t here to commit to just one man. Ever since she woke up as the main character of an otome game, she’s been grinding her way through all four male leads–both in bed and with the game’s likeability scores. Now that she’s hit the finish line, Joo-ah is ready to settle down with her harem of hotties… But wait, why are they starting to give her the cold shoulder? The game might not be over just yet!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: My Hot Harem Has Turned Cold On Me!

189041.description:
In a world where superpowers are a gift to protect the weak and fight evil, Suou Kouki has always dreamed of becoming a hero. But when his moment of despair awakens a hidden power, his dream quickly turns into a nightmare. Now, armed with a dangerous ability, Suou finds himself on a path he never expected—one where the line between hero and villain is perilously thin. The Raven Dark Hero is a gripping manga that explores the dark side of power, ambition, and morality, as Suou's journey forces him to confront the consequences of becoming the very thing he once sought to destroy.

(Source: Titan Manga)

title.native: 漆黒のダークヒーロー～ヒーローに憧れた俺が、あれよあれよとラスボスに!?～
title.romaji: Shikkoku no Dark Hero: Hero ni Akogareta Ore ga, Areyo Areyo to Last Boss ni!?

189042.description:
At the age of four, Ruiwen exhibits Go skills more remarkable than the great majority of her male peers'. When she grows up to be a professional player, she realizes that decades of gender inequality in Go have greatly disadvantaged female players. Consequently, she sets her sights on learning from the best and overcoming learning barriers as a woman, all in the hope of making her mark in the male-dominated world of Go.

(Source: WebComics, edited)

189043.description:
Adeline, daughter of an earl, was offered an engagement from the Dragonkin Realm. They wanted her to be the "Mate" for the third prince. All Dragonkins have to find their "Mate" and take them to their castle built on the floating island and live together, although their lifespans might be different. Adeline was fragile...she could hear that everyone in the castle criticized her as someone not worth being the Mate to the prince. Even the prince himself seemed to hate her. She ended her miserable life by someone's poison. 250 years after, Adeline was born to the same world. And again, she received an invitation from the Dragonkin for a ball to find their Mate. She tries to run away...not knowing that there was a secret beyond this invitation.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: だって望まれない番ですから

189044.description:
At first, Yan Dong fell for his hands, but soon, he grew to love everything about him. Unaware of his own feelings, he found himself visiting the beauty salon more often, while Lan Qiu, a rookie without even a hairstylist’s license, was surprised to be specifically requested each time. Though he tried to hide it, Lan Qiu couldn't ignore how Yan Dong’s small gestures started to affect him. The moment they both realized it wasn’t just a one-sided crush, they embraced the warmest time of their lives together.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

189045.description:
After falling victim to a deepfake scandal, Tae-Ri seeks justice at the police station. There, she meets Prosecutor Chi-Kyung Park — a man as composed and calculating as he is impossible to read. But when she refuses his settlement offer, his calm begins to unravel, and a dangerous obsession takes hold.

(Source: Manta)

189047.description:
"Anyone will do. Find me someone who can get married immediately," Yamanouchi Morio said to his senpai, who works for a matrimonial agency. Maybe such a request would not have been so shocking, if it hadn't come from a man who had been a full recluse for the last 10 years.

However, his senpai, in his shock, makes a mistake and sends Morio a tall, blond foreign man who doesn't speak a word of Japanese and is running from a troubled past himself...!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

189050.description:
Coffee shop worker Hirayama Shun is so handsome that customers praise him every day. However, he is fed up with being treated with contempt by a regular customer, Mao Nakadai. Then, one day, he meets MAO, a beautiful streamer girl on a video site and falls in love at first sight. He is actually an idol otaku, and when he watches her previous videos, he discovers that he is a cross-dressing guy. Although he is supposed to be straight, Shun is perplexed by his crush on MAO, even though he knows she is the same sex as him. He then discovers that MAO has similar characteristics to Nakadai, the regular customer...!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.
189050.hashtag: #隠し味にはすこし甘い下心
synonyms: The secret ingredient is a slightly sweet ulterior motive

title.native: 隠し味にはすこし甘い下心
title.romaji: Kakushi Aji ni wa Sukoshi Amai Shitagokoro

189051.description:
Who was that guy that once said, “An army marches on its stomach”? When hapless agricultural science student Jangcheol Kim starts playing the fantasy MMORPG “Paladins of Blood” to escape the stress of school life, he never imagined he would end up inside the game, much less as its final boss. How can a ruthless demon overlord win over his subjects? Perhaps with potatoes.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: วิถีชาวนาของราชาปีศาจ

title.english: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!

189052.description:
Bianca is just another noble lady with a simple dream: to marry into a dukedom and enjoy a life of luxury. But everything changes when she stumbles upon a book—one that casts her as the villainess, doomed to stand in the way of her real-life fiancé’s love story with a commoner girl. As Bianca realizes the book accurately depicts her own fate, she refuses to accept her tragic ending. Can she rewrite her story, or is she simply destined to become a villainess?

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: ถ้าเป็นนางร้าย ขอตายดีกว่า

title.english: I'm a Villainess, but I Won't Live Like One

189053.description:
Ha Si-Yeon, 30, who retired from being a popular idol and is now an actress, suddenly has a crush on Han Eun-Gyeol, a small business male idol. She, who was always used to being loved, now has a crush! Will she be able to keep her true identity a secret idol fan until the end? A heart-pounding secret idol fan romance!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: One Day, I Suddenly Got a Crush
One Day, I Suddenly Become a Stan

189054.description:
In a world where powerful beings are ranked by abilities, Key Academy is a battleground for the elite. Jelack, a mysterious new student, comes in as a bottom-tier Level D student. As students regularly spar to flaunt their powers, keeping her low rank a secret becomes increasingly difficult. Jelack trains in the shadows, aiming to rise above her D status. With unknown reasons for her transfer and her past shrouded in secrecy, she must uncover her true potential to survive the fierce hierarchy of the academy. Every day is a fight for recognition and respect, and Jelack is determined to prove her worth.

(Source: Tappytoon)

189055.description:
Roy isn't your average crime-fighting agent. She sees visions in her dreams-visions that come true soon after. Using this gift of foresight, she predicts crimes ahead of time. One night, she has a dream about making passionate love to a man she had never seen before, which makes her uneasy because her dreams always become real. What's more, this man keeps popping up in the crime scenes she foresees. Just who is this mysterious man? Why does he keep showing up in her dreams and reality?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

189056.description:
Aristasha, the noble lady of House Verdic, is adored by both the Iron-Blooded Duke, Evan, and his sword-master brother, Leon. Yet despite her status and beauty, and the years since she first made her debut, she has never taken a lover. Curious about passion and eager to explore the pleasures denied to her, she secretly arranges to meet a gigolo—only to be intercepted by Evan himself.

“If you wish to learn, and I refuse to let a stranger touch you… wouldn’t it be best if I taught you myself?”

From that night on, the men she once saw as brothers begin to look upon her with something far more seductive than mere protectiveness.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: In The Night, At The Duke's Mansion

title.english: Beyond the Walls of the Duke's Mansion

189057.description:
German tennis national coach Yuf Gnabry never expected to be charmed at the Olympics until he met South Korea’s rising star Son Rayeon. After a single practice match with her, Yuf is blown away by her familiar playstyle and her relentless pursuit of his attention. On the court, Rayeon is a prodigy, but off the court, she is a woman with a dangerous desire. One night, Yuf finds Rayeon waiting for him in front of his room with a mischievous smile. Can Yuf resist the rising star who refuses to take no for an answer?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.
synonyms: [Athletes' Village Where Love Blossoms] Heat Balance

title.english: Love is a Sport: Hit Balance

189058.description:
Beom-Yun, a cursed prince, weds Chung-Hui, a lame, twice-wed woman used as a living talisman. The jaded prince finds himself consumed by love for this princess, who is nothing more than a pawn in a scramble for power. To protect her, he’ll seize the throne and drown the world in vengeance.

(Source: Manta, edited)

189059.description:
Jeon Woo-Chi was the greatest taoist 500 years ago, and now he's ready to take over the era of social media! All he dreams of is a peaceful life as a successful online streamer. However, Kang Jin-Hee, the granddaughter of a man Woo-Chi saved in the past, comes to him with a mysterious scroll and zombie-like monsters in hot pursuit. As he tries to find the source of these monsters, he's invited to Exceed, a competition for top streamers, only to find there might be a link between the two...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 配信界の天才道士チョン・ウチ

189060.description:
Sequel of Aphorism.

Note: The chapter count got reset and a subtitle added, but the volume numbering wasn't reset. The first volume of this manga is thus compiled as the 15th of the original release.

title.native: アホリズム 第弐部

189061.description: A short story based on Jorge Luis Borges' "The Library of Babel".

189062.description:
“Once I’m back from the battlefield, perhaps you’ll share your heart with me then.”

Those were the final words of Prince Lochlan of the Routen Kingdom to his fiancée April Campbell before he rode away to war, never to return. Left heartbroken and destitute as the neglected ward of her greedy uncle and his mistress, April desires nothing more than her freedom, almost as ardently as she wants her prince to return to life. When April is brought to the royal palace for her beloved prince’s funeral, she notices something unusual about his twin brother, Crown Prince Dominic…

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.native: 私たちは婚約を失った

189063.description: Prequel manga adaptation of the Suikoden STAR LEAP gacha game.

title.native: 幻想水滸伝 STAR LEAP ～星々の軌跡～
title.romaji: Gensou Suikoden STAR LEAP ~Hoshiboshi no Kiseki~

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 維新の夜明け編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Ishin no Yoake-hen

synonyms: I Have Zero Magic Power, But I’m The Strongest With Physical Magic!

title.native: 魔力ゼロだけど物理魔法で最強です
title.romaji: Maryoku Zero dakedo Butsuri Mahou de Saikyou desu

189066.description:
There's little difference between being alive and being dead. Either way is fine…anything is fine…

Before meeting Fuuka, Kuroo lived in a world without color. Through their relationship, he felt that he'd discovered the warmth in his own heart. However, an incident takes Fuuka away from him. Consumed by despair in a world without her, Kuroo follows a mysterious cat and ends up in another world—one where Fuuka is still alive…?

If I had never met you, if I had never lost you, if I could meet you again—what if life truly allowed such "ifs"…? A fantastical parallel-world love story.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

189067.description:
"Revive, Human." Ai Shinogami, the weakest recruit in the United Galactic Army, was supposed to have died on the battlefield. However, the chest pierced by the Kaiki, humanity's enemy, has healed, and the torn arm has reattached itself. On the verge of death, Ai made a contract with Nosferatu, the king of the Kaiki, to coexist with him inside his body. Through this contract, Ai can revive even after dying multiple times, and his physical abilities continue to enhance as he becomes one with Nosferatu. Ai always returns alone from battles where his entire unit is wiped out, earning him the nickname "Grim Reaper" and inspiring fear in others. Yet, Ai continues to stand up against the Kaiki for humanity's sake, no matter how many times he dies.

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: Deadly Strong, Becoming Stronger With Each Resurrection
Imprisonment is a Virtue ~ I'm the Trash of Society, but will you be Grateful ~

title.native: 懲役一善　～社会のゴミですけど感謝してくれますか？～
title.romaji: Choueki Ichi Zen - Shakai no Gomi Desu kedo Kansha Shite Kuremasu ka ？

189071.description:
A timid high school girl ghost, Ida Jeong. She has been possessed by Chae Rim, who has beauty, wealth, and popularity! She clumsily imitates Chae Rim, but... one person finds out about her identity. It's Baek Yi-Sak, Chae Rim's crush. "I'll help you pretend to be Chae Rim." This kind but somehow suspicious male student. Can I trust him? What is the secret of my death? A thrilling occult romance comic!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: 彼に告白してはいけません

189072.description:
Fudou Keiichi (42 years old, office worker, single) leads an unremarkable daily life—except for one thing that brings him joy. His secret passion is running an anonymous account on the up-and-coming social media platform "KLART"! However, before he realizes it, his beloved secret account is caught in a massive scandal—all because of an insanely popular high school boy influencer!? An unprecedented, extraordinary friendship is about to be born!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

189073.description:
Maximum relaxation! A relaxed and fluffy life together with a man and a pet (!?) begins!

One day, Mochizuki is diagnosed with a rare condition called "Fluffy Syndrome" by a doctor.

To improve his condition, he needs "healing" and it seems that he can continue living as before by living with a specialized therapist arranged by the doctor.

The rabbit beastman named "Fauzah Fabroni (Fau)" that is introduced to him turns out to be a skilled therapist who can provide healing...!?

(source: Comic Porta, translated)

189074.description:
One day, Sekine Tasuku, a part-time worker, suddenly gains the ability to produce fire from his hands. While using his power to light a cigarette, his coworker Harumi Ryousuke accidentally catches him in the act. But to Tasuku’s surprise—Ryousuke can produce water!? After work, Ryousuke invites Tasuku to his decades-old, rundown apartment. With a serious expression, he proposes a shocking idea—room-sharing!?!? Though uncertain about their newfound supernatural abilities, Ryousuke seems excited about one unexpected advantage: using fire and water powers to save on gas and water bills. Tasuku, tempted by the idea of splitting rent for a cheaper living arrangement, agrees. Thus begins their unexpected cohabitation, just as Ryousuke had hoped!

Joined by quirky neighbors—Juumonji Munetaka, Tasuku’s cousin Higashi Kouhei, and the mysterious cat-shaped keychain Nyanko that Kouhei found—this is a laid-back, heartwarming slice-of-life story about their frugal yet extraordinary daily adventures!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: ゆるデイズ～異能力系男子達のゆるゆる生活～
title.romaji: Yuru Days: Inouryokukei Danshitachi no Yuruyuru Seikatsu

189075.description: Jade, the third son of a baron, was kicked out of his home after failing to get a job at the "job change ceremony" when he came of age, but he remembers that the world he is in now is the game world he used to play in his previous life. Jade regains his memories of his previous life, and believes that he can become the strongest adventurer in the world, and uses his knowledge of the game to become an out-of-the-box adventurer.

title.native: 無職の最強賢者～ジョブが得られず追放されたが、ゲームの知識で異世界最強～
title.romaji: Mushoku no Saikyou Kenja: Job ga Erarezu Tsuihousareta ga, Game no Chishiki de Isekai Saikyou

title.native: イチャラブ発情ケモ娘

189077.description:
"Horonggak" is a very famous café that everyone wants to visit these days... the only problem is that it's never open! But behind these café doors is a haven for stranded vagrants. Grandma Ma-Go, a deity from Jeju Island, with the help of Woo-Jin and Jachung-Bi, finds vagrants who have lost their way and brings them back to the café. But with so many of these vagrants being bad or mischievous, will Ma-Go find a way to help them get on the right path to living in their new home in Seoul?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 明かりが灯るともしび亭

189078.description:
When Serenity Theophano rescues an elderly man on the streets, she is inflicted with a deadly curse, solvable only in a limited time. Desperate, she delves into books for a cure until she encounters the cold Duke Aaron Lorang, after which the curse's brand miraculously disappears! Forced to remain close to the duke as an attendant, Serenity navigates his deep mistrust and suspicion of her. Initially planning to use him to escape her curse, she unexpectedly becomes entangled in a new predicament—the duke's growing obsession with her. With time running out, can Serenity untangle the curse binding her fate?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Cursed Maid in the Duke's Castle
公爵城の呪われたメイド様

title.english: The Cursed Attendant of the Duke's Castle

189079.description:
Her boyfriend’s fondest desire…is every man’s dream!!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2019-11

title.english: Today is the Start of OOO

189080.description:
Sang-Hyeon Kim has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation. After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever. But when the head director of a major entertainment company hands him a mysterious bath bomb that transforms him into his past-life self, he's suddenly staring at an unbelievably beautiful... woman? Sang-Hyeon's second shot at fame is about to begin—in the most unexpected way!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Today's Han Yoil Is a Woman
美少女アイドル練習生の俺、メンバーに正体がバレそうです

title.native: イキ♥地獄リフレに堕落る天使界隈ちゃん♥
title.romaji: Iki♥Jigoku Refle ni Ochiru Tenshi Kaiwai-chan♥

title.native: 失神♥地獄リフレに堕落る天使界隈ちゃん♥
title.romaji: Shisshin♥Jigoku Refle ni Ochiru Tenshi Kaiwai-chan♥

title.native: レッドフードブロンド

189084.description:
The Monkey King’s journey was over. But a new story begins with an impossible crime -- his master, Sanzang, has gone missing. His new mission is to dive into the Murim, a world where mortals and their martial arts rival the power of the gods and unravel this mystery. The threads of fate reveal not only allies, but foes from his past. The Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal has been unchained, but this new arduous journey may yet prove to be his most challenging yet...

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Monkey King’s Journey to the Murim

189086.description:
For centuries, human beings have been fascinated by dramatic stories of love, jealousy, and adventure. From ancient myths to modern soap operas, people just want to be entertained! But do you know the oldest myths of them all, those of Mesopotamia? Let Hongkki’s unique retelling guide you through an ancient world where the gods of nature still walk the land and timeless tales of destiny, love, and betrayal unfold.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

189087.description: Collects an extended version of the 2009 "Shin Mazinger Shogeki! H-hen" oneshot and the two-part crossover story "Cutie Honey vs Abashiri Ikka"

189088.description:
Lee Jung had it all. A handsome young man from a prestigious family, it seemed inevitable that he would live and die as a successful nobleman. However, life is full of the unexpected. When his father is suddenly condemned as a traitor, his good name gets sullied and he is forced to become a slave. Full of contempt for the family he now belongs to, Jung tries to seek revenge by hurting the daughter of the house, Seo Yi-Soo. Little does he know that she has many, many ways of "punishing" him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189089.description: 1981 Tankobon collecting the full 1976 serialization of "Change! Sabu" and the two-part short story "Hamaguri Dosse~!!"

title.native: 周防姉弟のちょっとついてる1日

189092.description: Maki meets a man named Tomonori who pays well. What does the word “dole” that he often uses mean? This is the story of a woman who falls for a scumbag man who nests on the dark side of society.

189093.description:
A girl named "78105" has been created as a test subject for breeding experiments with various creatures.
However, she herself refuses, saying she absolutely does not want to participate. The breeding experiment begins, ignoring the girl's voice.
Captured by an unknown creature, she is forcibly and violently captured by a sensation she has never felt before.
With her role engraved into her body, the girl comes to accept herself as a breeding bed...

189094.description:
After winning tickets to an old theme park on the outskirts of Tokyo, Casio and his friends brave the eerie rumors surrounding the place for a little winter adventure. However, what was supposed to be a fun day trip takes a horrific turn when one friend lures Casio away from the group—and stabs him to death. While he bleeds out, his friend tearfully begs him to save someone named Asebi. When Casio next awakens, time has rewound to the moment he set foot in the park that morning. Though he’s shaken and desperate for answers, his “second” day goes by without incident—until he tries to leave and snaps right back to that morning again. As he spirals into panic, a mysterious girl appears and introduces herself as Asebi. She tells him she’s been trapped in the park for a long time, reliving the same day over and over. Now Casio is caught in the loop as well…and according to Asebi, the only way out is to kill someone.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: The Neverending Winter, the Land of Broken Dreams
title.native: 終わらない冬、壊れた夢の国
title.romaji: Owaranai Fuyu, Kowareta Yume no Kuni

synonyms: 漫画喫茶瀬戸c104会場おまけ本
Manga Kissa Seto C104 Kaijou Omake Hon

title.native: 彼氏の匂いでチクニーする男の娘
title.romaji: Kareshi no Nioi de Chikunie suru Otokonoko

189097.description:
In the heart of Tokyo lies Animoe Animation Studios, where Tanaka Alexander works as a brilliant producer. But behind his success lies a mysterious past...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 殺し屋、アニメをつくる

189098.description:
Notes:
- Originally published as a one-shot in &.Emo Vol. 3, was then picked up for serialization.
- Includes one extra chapter.

189099.description:
Kyuhyun accidentally comes out when he unintentionally sends a photo of himself kissing his (ex-)boyfriend to a group chat. Panicked, he thinks, "I'm screwed. Someone already saw it." Unable to sleep properly and filled with fear, he walks into the lecture hall, only to meet Kibum’s intense gaze. "Hey, what time does your class end today?" That simple question marks the beginning of more frequent encounters between them. As they spend more time together, Kyuhyun’s fear gradually turns into excitement, and the atmosphere between them starts shifting in an unexpected direction. "Go out with me. I'll become the person you love."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.native: リクエストまんがまとめ

189101.description:
My younger brother who lives the perfect life that I made for him. Everything you enjoyed was mine. After her parents passed away, Lee Ryeong lived sacrificing for her twin brother Lee Seon. One day, when Lee Seon gets hurt before an important event, Lee Ryeong pretends to be Lee Seon for a month and lives her younger brother's life. As she experiences things she never had, her greed grows...

"I want to enjoy the things you enjoyed."

(Source: Naver, translated)

189103.description:
Soo-Hyeon’s peaceful life in the countryside, running a quaint general store and tending a garden, is upended when rumors spread of a luxury hotel project—and the arrival of Tae-Yeon, a gruff yet oddly charming director from S.W. Construction who looks more like a mob boss than a businessman. Despite warnings from the village grandmas to steer clear, Soo-Hyeon isn’t intimidated, even as Tae-Yeon’s attempts to “bribe” him with sweet treats start melting his defenses. But when an unexpected moment reveals Soo-Hyeon’s biggest secret, what starts as a clash of personalities turns into a tangled mix of sweetness, spice, and chaos that neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189104.description:
Despite his large build, Rinto has a gentle personality. He spends his days practicing sumo with his childhood friend Konatsu and others. However, one day, Konatsu tells him something that changes everything. This is a bittersweet coming-of-age story of a young sumo wrestler.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189105.description:
Nagi, an art university student, is dating Yuu, a senior from the folk song club and his next-door neighbor.

This is a special side story that revisits the day they first met, told from both Nagi and Yuu’s perspectives.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: あした愛かもしれない 番外編 "Rainy Day"
title.romaji: Ashita Ai Kamo Shirenai: Bangai-hen "Rainy Day"

189106.description: A girl is taken away, declared the so-called "Great Mermaid" who must return to her true origin, the sea. In her time spent in isolation, she meets a new friend - or is it a foe?

189107.description:
Includes 8 episodes of their daily life after the main story.

Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 52, was then licensed by Ichijinsha for digital release.
synonyms: あした愛かもしれない 番外編 ”きらめき”
Ashita Ai Kamo Shirenai Bangaihen Kirameki

189108.description:
Kei Maebara gets a job!! The bizarre and eerie world of public service, depicted by Ryukishi07, from Higurashi When They Cry.

In the 13th year of the Heisei era, in the Tokyo Metropolitan Area, Coastal Region... Due to the prolonged economic recession, the police force has weakened, and the growing number of disillusioned youth turning to semi-criminal lifestyles has led to a drastic decline in public safety... Amidst all this, Kei Maebara begins working at the district office. Can he become a respectable public servant?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 木っ端舞い散る その頃に

189110.description:
In June 2002, a shooting incident occurred at the 1813GP, the front-line unit of the Republic of Korea. Park Du-Il, a newly commissioned officer in the Military Police Investigation Division, is assigned to the investigation team, but as the investigation progresses, he encounters the uncomfortable truth hidden in the incident and his belief in justice begins to waver.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.

189111.description:
Ghost - the deadliest sniper who's left countless targets in his wake across countless battlefields. His next mark: the heiress of a corporate empire. But as the mission progresses, he finds himself invested in her love life...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189114.description:
Step into "The Creepy and Freaky," where fear is our commodity. Take your time, shop around, and immerse yourself in these tales of terror for as long as you please.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189119.description:
Since awakening as a fairy, Lichesia the Enchantress was constantly on the run from fairy hunters wanting to sell her. Now, hoping to learn who was really behind the hunters, she poses as 5-year-old Chesha to infiltrate the mysterious House Basillian... by getting adopted! But Count Basillian and his three sons are a peculiar bunch, and while they spoil Chesha, the count seems to be plotting something sinister. Can the Enchantress get her revenge and make it out of this strange house alive?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Baby Fairy Is a Villain

title.english: The Baby Fairy Is a Villainess

189122.description:
Yamaoka is forced to attend a language school by his company. This is where he meets a beautiful Korean instructor who begins to give him secret private lessons!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: 恋のしかた、教えてください

189124.description:
Despite her unquestioning loyalty to the emperor as his knight, Iona is left to die on the battlefield by her uncaring master. The last person she expects to come to her rescue in her final moments is her husband, Duke Leroy Hann, who was forced into a political marriage with her. Once she dies and wakes up as her past self, Iona decides to abandon the emperor and devote herself to making Leroy happy. Can she make this unlikely marriage work this time around, despite Leroy's distrust and the people determined to come between them...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

189125.description:
A spinoff of the hit Square Enix novel series, From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman.

Surena Lysrandra has finished her tutelage in Beryl Gardinant’s remote countryside dojo and strikes out on her own, working as an adventurer. Indeed, she soon rockets up the ranks, angling toward the pinnacle of the guild: Blank Rank, something only a select few across the entire world have ever achieved. In the midst of her meteoric rise, she receives a request from Logan, an aged adventurer who was once a force to be reckoned with in his prime. That request leads her to meet Nell, a young girl with adventurer aspirations of her own. Little does Surena know that this encounter will see her reach new heights. This is the tale of a journey to the very top, tracing the paths of a young girl and an adventurer chasing the example her master left for her.

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

title.english: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman: The Twin Dragonblade's Journey to the Top
title.native: 片田舎のおっさん、剣聖になる外伝　竜双剣の軌跡
title.romaji: Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru Gaiden: Ryuusouken no Kiseki

189126.description:
A shy freshman girl has a crush on a charming sophomore in her class. She dreams of a relationship with him, but when he starts talking to her anonymously as "Anonymous7," she discovers his hidden promiscuous side. What happens when her innocent crush meets reality?

(Source: Toomics)

189127.description:
In 2006, Kang Hae-Na, known as the troublemaker of Beomchon High School, is actually just a young girl who dreams of love! One day, while reading the comic book , Hae-Na suddenly finds herself possessed by the body of 'Kang Hae-Na, a normal student at Beomchon High School' in the year 2025. If she wants to return to her original body, she is told to find her destined partner here... Destined partner?? Here?!!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Life Tips of a Pretty Girl

189128.description:
Seven enlistments. Infinite service. Zero discharge. Kim Jae-hwan, a lowly private, has been trapped in a never-ending military time loop, forced to relive his conscription over and over again. No matter what he does, he always ends up back at square one—Private, Day 1. The only clue to breaking the cycle? A mysterious line in his military diary: “It was truly the perfect military life.” Now, in his 7th round of enlistment, Jae-hwan is ready to do whatever it takes— follow every order, befriend every superior, survive every absurdity— to finally write those cursed words… and escape. But in a place where logic is warped and sanity is optional, can one soldier truly find the perfect military life?

(Source: Naver, translated)

189129.description:
Kang Taeyang, a chef who chased his dreams. One day, he lost everything due to a single choice. But an opportunity came to Taeyang, who was spending hopeless days working odd jobs. [Aurora is hiring employees.] A single line of text changed everything for him!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Strongest Chef in Another World

189130.description:
A younger brother who is a student at Seoul National University and an older brother who is a repeat student. The two identical twin brothers are so different. Jun-Seo, who has been compared to his younger brother Jun-Su his whole life, ends up wearing his younger brother's pajamas at his mother's suggestion, and thus begins his precarious campus life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

189131.description:
For over 25 years, Murata Ramu has investigated the dark underbelly of society. Now, his chilling book is finally being adapted into manga!
This series brings to life the most terrifying encounters from his research—moments when he came face-to-face with incomprehensible human insanity.
A spine-tingling collection of true horror stories from a writer who knows the depths of society’s darkness all too well.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)
synonyms: 人怖 狂気が潜む人間の深淵
Hitokowa: Kyouki ga Hisomu Ningen no Shinen
人怖2 日常に隠された原初の恐怖
Hitokowa 2: Nichijou ni Kakusareta Gensho no Kyoufu

189132.description:
Karui (bottom) is a playboy through and through despite having a boyfriend.
Said boyfriend, the possessive Shigeta (top) adores him.
They are both university students and members of the same band.
This is their clingy love story.

(Source: DLsite)

189133.description:
The first official spin-off comic adaptation of the hugely popular title from SQEX Novel, "A Country Old Man Becomes a Sword Saint ~I was just a country sword master, but my accomplished students won't let me go~"!! A girl becomes a student under Beryl Gardenant, a sword master at a dojo in Biden Village, a rural area of ​​the Kingdom of Leveris. The girl's name is Vissel Habeler. She hates to lose and practices harder than anyone else, and she quickly stands out in the dojo, but at the same time, she awakens to the power of magic... This is the story of a girl who dreams of becoming a sword master, and aims to reach the heights with sword and magic.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
synonyms: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Side Story: Tale of the Magic Knight

title.english: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman: The Mage Knight's Origin
title.native: 片田舎のおっさん、剣聖になる外伝　はじまりの魔法剣士
title.romaji: Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru Gaiden: Hajimari no Mahou Kenshi

189134.description:
Tokko Private Academy is one of Japan's most notorious delinquent schools! To claim the title of top delinquent, Yamadano must defeat the current kingpin known as the "Beast." When he raids the gym storage room where the "Beast" is rumored to hang out, what he finds there is...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189135.description:
Living a self-destructive lifestyle, young Aoi finds her room visited by various symbols of spring - cherry blossoms and butterflies - all silently watching over her days. A new tale of love and life from the unique mind.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: アオイの部屋にまた春が来た
title.romaji: Aoi no Heya ni Mata Haru ga Kita

189136.description:
A story about a world where people control weapons made with new technology.

(Source: Jump Rookie, translated)

189139.description:
Jang Ha-Eun, who was known as the Lamb in the best cult Cheonji Jaerim Church on the peninsula. While living an ordinary life away from the cult, his family was murdered by Cheonji Jaerim Church. Revenge on Cheonji Jaerim Church that took everything from him. The beginning of that revenge is... Becoming the leader of Cheonji Jaerim Church.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

189140.description:
Midori Mori, 25 years old, is an extremely ordinary teacher. However, the class he is in charge of, commonly known as SSR class, is a very special class where only the elite of the elite gather! Midori was spending his days in the class, being pushed around by these genius students.
Suddenly, however, those days come to an end. One day, all the students suddenly disappeared from this world! Green sees the magic circle that took the students away and jumps into it without hesitation to save them. Then, he finds a world he has never seen before...?
A slapstick story of youth in a different world, between a cheat high school student and a mediocre teacher!
synonyms: 異世界先生～凡人教師は天才生徒達と異世界で青春〈アオハル〉する～

title.native: 異世界先生～凡人教師は天才生徒達と異世界で青春する～
title.romaji: Isekai Sensei: Bonjin Kyoushi wa Tensai Seito-tachi to Isekai de Seishun suru

189141.description:
Every day is hellish due to bullying from bullies and his mother's obsession. Joo Min-Seong, a victim of bullying, begins to negotiate to escape the worst life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

189142.description:
Once known as the White Night Witch, Alisia is reborn without her powers as a young princess neglected by her father, the emperor. When she regains her magic after hearing the news of his death in battle, she plans to rule the chaotic empire herself... That is, until the emperor returns alive. Now, Alisia must mend fences with her father while also handling schemes and secrets lurking around them. Will these two, so different yet so similar, make amends and work together? Or is it all too late?

(Source: Tapas)

189143.description:
Eun-Yu’s first love was like hay fever — tingly and impossible to ignore. At 25, she gave up on her dreams and herself, hoping never to see Jae-Ha again. But when he returns colder and more dangerous, he shatters her peace, reigniting a fire she thought had long been gone.

(Source: Manta)

189145.description:
One day a strange man with a red axe asks Irene to eat her... how'd he know her true identity?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and epilogue

189146.description:
"I really need a helping hand, and you have nowhere to go. A match made in heaven!"

"I provide free meals and accommodation."

A man who seems poetic and refined on the surface but harbors a dark side, and a former gangster determined to turn over a new leaf and live a calmer, more meaningful life, cross paths. Love makes you want to keep a journal. Love inspires poetry. Love compels you to write. Love turns words into something beautiful.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: あなたの叙情的恋愛のために

189147.description:
Dominica, a vampire hiding her true identity while living among humans, finds herself attacked one night by a vampire hunter named Aran. But instead of being his victim, she overpowers him—and ends up spending an unexpectedly thrilling night with her perfect match. Just when she thought their encounter would be a one-time thing, a string of mysterious incidents began to unfold in her territory. As Dominica hunts for the truth behind these events, she keeps running into Aran, and their fates become increasingly intertwined...

(Source: Lezhin US)

189148.description:
"Make sure... your future husband... is ridiculously handsome...!"

Such was the dying wish of Leah's mother. So when the occasion presents itself to fulfill that promise by marrying the neighboring kingdom's hunky ruler, Leah doesn't think twice. Sure, Fritan is a cold and desolate land, but who cares? Her new husband is total eye-candy! Now, it's up to this unlikely queen to navigate foreign politics, budding romance, and her newfound, mysterious powers... All while enjoying the view!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Sorry, I Got Distracted By Your Looks

189149.description:
Sien is your average adorable kid living in the country with her kind dad... or so she thought. It turns out her dad is actually an heir of a grand duke banished from an evil family! Sien will do anything to protect her innocent dad from the wickedness that awaits them. Join Sien on her adventure to keep her tyrant dad safe!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: I Will Protect My Tyrant Dad!

189151.description:
Prince Alec, the troublemaker of the Royal Family, runs into some trouble himself when he discovers he is being hunted by assassins. With magic involved in this deadly scheme, the only one who can protect him is Victoria, the Witch of Bitter Cold, who offers her help in exchange for a “small” favor. But as her title implies, Victoria is devoid of human emotions and will stop at nothing to get what she wants. Although Prince Alec tries to maintain some distance between them, this proves to be difficult the longer he is stuck with his icy protector...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: To the Witch Who Forgot Her Bird

189152.description:
The Blooming estate was in an uproar when nineteen year old Rowena Blooming suddenly went missing, only to be discovered without any recollection of what happened. Rowena was the most confused, left with no memories, but the faint lingering traces of a feeling, or dream she had. Soon, she discovers that something else is lingering around her: a specter of a man who only she can see and hear that identifies itself as Enoch Claude, a member of the notorious Margraves house of Claude. Enoch also claims he is hailing from four years into the future, and is entangled with Rowena in this past timeline as an incorporeal spirit that can occasionally make contact with her, physically and emotionally. The caring Rowena attempts to help Enoch get back to his own life, while his presence as her guardian spirit grows stronger by day.
While the ghostly lord with a dark past is clearly hiding that the two of them are acquainted in the future on bad terms, he grows closer to the Rowena of the past, as they discover more about the reason for their entanglement. Why was Enoch sent back to be her guardian spirit? What is the secret he is hiding? What new future lies for this pair, divided by time?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

189153.description:
I possessed an errand child who brought meals to the male protagonist who was captured as a test subject at the lab. If the experiment was successful and the male protagonist gained power, the lab would be engulfed in flames. So I tried to run away before that, but I felt bad for the male protagonist who was suffering from the cruel experiment. So I secretly took care of various things while avoiding the researchers' eyes.

"Come to think of it, what's your name?"
"I don't have a name..."
"You make me one."
"Huh?"

I somehow became a little close to the male protagonist. "Are you going to abandon me? Don't do that."
"Ah... but-"
"Anis, do you mind if I'm wrong?"
"Ugh... No. No, I don't."
"Then stay by my side."

However, the only one who can cure him who is suffering from the side effects of the experiment is the original female protagonist.

I tried to help him and leave secretly so that he could find his partner...

"You promised not to abandon me. But, was it all a lie?”
With the burning laboratory in the background, Emilien smiled with cold eyes.
“A good child should keep his promises.”

The temperature of the hand touching my cheek is cold. The red eyes close as if they are going to engulf me.
“Answer, aren’t you going to tell me?”
...What should I do?
I think I missed my chance to run away.

(Source: NaverSeries, translated)
synonyms: I Helped the Imprisoned Male Lead and He Became an Obsessive Man

189154.description:
Former management consultant Mari is reincarnated as the villain princess Violetta in the otome game "Grandeur Love Revolution". If things continue as planned, she will be executed...

She absolutely does not want to meet such an end!! So she reforms herself and starts to act for the people and the country, but her former consultant blood boils and she becomes the leader of the kingdom's revival!? Furthermore, the target of her capture, who was supposed to hate her, and the heroine who bullied her, are also fond of her.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: グランドール王国再生録 破滅の悪役王女ですが救国エンドをお望みです
title.romaji: Grandeur Oukoku Saiseiroku: Hametsu no Akuyaku Oujo desu ga Kyuukoku End wo Onozomi desu

189155.description:
Hee-Young and Seo-Won get divorced after a long marriage. However, due to her fertility problems and other reasons, Hee-Young promises to continue living together while they hide their divorce. The two are able to date freely, and even feel comfortable enough to give each other dating advice. Then one day, Hee-Young gets pregnant with her boyfriend's child.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: I Am Living With My Ex-Husband
ฉัน เขา และสามีเก่า

189156.description:
"Siena's refreshing counterattack and fateful love story after a lifetime of being just a sidekick!"
After a life filled with misfortune and standing on the sidelines, Siena faces death—only to discover that her only friend, Daisy, had always seen her as nothing more than a mere sidekick.
Realizing she had been manipulated and used throughout her entire life, she is struck by despair. But at that very moment, a miracle happens—Siena returns to the past, to the day she was eighteen!

(Source: NaverWebtoon, translated)
synonyms: I'm Done Being Your Best Friend

189157.description:
Amelia's best friend Tyler suggested on the night of their high school graduation that they get married if they were still single when they were twenty-eight years old. She didn't believe it'd ever happen... Ten years later, at their reunion, the duo get tired of their friends bragging about their families and sneak out into the Las Vegas night. The next morning, Amelia can't believe her eyes. Tyler is sleeping naked next to her! She then remembers what happened the night before-they'd gotten drunk and married one another at a local chapel. Later when Tyler learns about Amelia's pregnancy, he says they should live together to decide whether to stay best friends or become a real wife and husband!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Thirty Days to Win His Wife
title.native: 大富豪の三十日間の求婚

189158.description:
A researcher who has loved living creatures since childhood is out in the forest for a routine survey—until something huge suddenly drops into view from the sky!?

For a moment, he fears he’s about to be eaten… but instead, the massive creature—a mysterious Kurokosagi—starts cozying up to him and growing more attached with each encounter.

(Source: EastPress, translated)

title.native: クロコサギ人外さんと研究員くん。

189159.description:
Nick Ramirez built his massive wealth in a single generation and is dead set against marriage. He is an arrogant but handsome man who insists marriage is an act of folly that reduces one’s assets. Tess was determined to keep her relationship with Nick strictly professional, but she couldn’t resist the temptation and took just one bite of the forbidden fruit. Nick regretted the impulsive love affair and never made another personal approach… Now, months later, Nick has appeared again—has he found out about the secret Tess has been keeping from him?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

189161.description:
She's so energetic that people around her don't treat her like a girl. One day, she accidentally frees Noah, the prince of the demon world, who was sealed away in the chapel at the back of the school. In order to return Noah to the demon world, she must collect the scattered magical power.

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

189162.description:
A thirst for revenge drags Raymond into a sinister game at his new boarding school, as he finds himself the mouse within a dorm of twisted cats who wish to devour and defile him in the worst ways imaginable.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: ชีวิตสังเวช

189163.description:
Ratan the mage is being pursued by the knights of the inquisition for studying the forbidden Red Curse. When he seeks refuge in The Black Forest, he runs into its deadly resident knight in steel armor who happens to be the curse's victim. Thankfully, Ratan's offer to lift the curse keeps the knight from killing him. But the solution involves some heated action in the bedroom, and Ratan isn't so sure that he'll survive to see another day...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Notes:
- Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.
- Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: [Difficult First XX Anthology] Knight of the Red Curse

title.english: My First XXX: The Black Knight Under the Red Curse

189164.description:
When a zombie outbreak overruns Seoul, the government abandons the city to its fate. Amid the chaos, ex-special forces bodyguard Shin-U fights to protect his skittish charge, Te-Bek. But as every day brings them closer to death, their bond grows harder to resist. Can love survive an apocalypse?

(Source: Manta)

189165.description:
Tae-Ri dreamed of living a life like one of her favorite teen drama flicks. But at 20 years old and now gearing up for college entrance exams, that life is no longer in the cards for her. Or is it? When a desperate wish for true love transports her into the teen drama "Once Upon a One Night Mistake," Tae-Ri finally gets her chance to experience the passionate love life she's always fantasized about!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 転生したらアメリカのセレブ高校生になりました

title.english: Once Upon a One Night Mistake

189166.description:
Shiqian, a psychiatrist by profession, helps a friend to make up the number of people in her talent show, but she doesn't expect that because of her unique persona, she will soon be voted by her fans to make her debut! When Shiqian, who only wants to be lazy, is trying to find a way to get out of her debut, a five-year-old bully calls her mommy. A five-year-old bully called her mommy and threatened to adopt her?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: My Financial Backer Is Only 5 Years Old

189167.description:
In a world of swords and magic, where the Goddess is revered, Lyell Walt was fortunate enough to be born the first son and heir to an earldom. That is, until his parents disown him for losing pitifully in a fight with his younger sister, Ceres. Lyell had once been hailed as a prodigy—a wonder child—but the birth of his sister changed everything. After Ceres wounds him in their duel, an enigmatic old man swoops in to rescue Lyell and bestows upon him a necklace containing a jewel that has been blessed by the goddesses and passed down through the last seven generations of Walt leaders. As Lyell sets out, necklace in hand, will he be able to prove himself despite his humiliating loss to his sister? And moreover, will he be able to solve the mystery behind Ceres’s monstrous strength and the strange sway she seems to hold over his entire family?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

189168.description:
As a player in a metaverse martial arts game, I was reborn as an NPC in the game. I not only retain the memory of my last life but also become a super negative NPC because I can actually kill creeps, level up, and acquire treasures like a player! In this life, I’ll strive to be the king of the village!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Indestructible Body Of Vajra Of The Village Leader

189169.description:
In second year of middle school, Musubu Shiomi is just living an ordinary life. But on the graduation day of her Senpai, her (former) childhood friend Shizu-chan she estranged from, she is asked to take a picture together with him. “I’m going to Kitakou High School...”

"I will also go to Kitakou High School!” Musubu fulfills her promise she kept for an entire year and mages to swiftly enroll at the same high school as Shizu-chan, but…

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)
synonyms: I'll be entangled in thoughts, with you someday.

title.native: 想い絡まり、いつか君と。

189171.description:
It's the usual classroom, the usual lunch break, but there's something unusual about Ai-chan...? A slightly strange and sad friendship drama from the newcomer behind “Boku ga Shinu made no 24-jikan."

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

title.native: あいちゃんともう一日

189172.description:
The man leading up So-Young's new team at work not only has a handsome face but is clearing packing something sizable in his pants. She can't help but steal glances at the prominent outline until one day, gazing at her like prey caught in a trap, Tae-Kyung asks, "Do you really like it that much?"

(Source: Manta)

title.english: My Secret Business with My Boss

189173.description:
Yoo-Joo has a specific taste when it comes to men: they must have broad, beautiful chests. She’s never met her ideal chest before, until she finds it on Dojin, her next door neighbor since childhood. After a drunken night where Yoo-Joo gets to have a taste of Dojin’s deliciously perfect pecs, she earns his forgiveness by being his errand girl and promising to let him do the same to her if she ever lays hands on his chest again. But there’s no way it will happen again, obviously. Or so she thought…

(Source: Tappytoon)

189174.description:
A thrilling manga path for those who love shoujo manga! The one who is disrupting my youth is my childhood friend, a professional shoujo manga artist.

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

189175.description:
Kurumi, falls in love with Kamiyama, a slightly eccentric occult enthusiast. While she was happy to hear his confession, what awaited her was a series of dates that were too demanding...?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)
synonyms: I Love You So Much It's Evil

title.native: あくまで好きすぎるだけ
大切に人間として育てていただいたのにオナホでごめんなさい♥ 準備号
title.romaji: Taisetsu ni Ningen to Shite Sodate te Itadaita no ni Onaho de Gomennasai♥Junbigou

189178.description:
In the mortal realm, Black Dawn and White Night share the same body in a symbiotic relationship. But when they lost their Jade of Invisibility, they are forced to disguise themselves in human skin to survive.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

189180.description:
Yu is now enrolled at the arcane academy Night Raven College. It’s winter break, and while most others have traveled home, Yu discovers that Grim and another mysterious student are still at school. As they wander the solitary halls, they find that the supposedly empty school is far from desolate! They are not alone…

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.english: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Manga – Book of Scarabia
title.native: ディズニーツイステッドワンダーランド ザコミックエピソードオブスカラビア
title.romaji: Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Comic Episode of Scarabia

189183.description: Based on the life of real life historical figure/potentially mythological artist Hidari Jingoro. Jingoro is an extremely talented woodworker, sculptor, painter, wordsmith, you name it. But when his lover, Osen suddenly falls ill he must use his artistic skills to make her healthy again.

189184.description:
Tsurumaki’s a section chief who can cook. His superior, Kotou, cannot and can be a reeeal drag about it sometimes. When they bump into each other after work at a veggie stand and Kotou reveals his girlfriend left him, he begs Tsurumaki to help show him how to cook. Tsurumaki agrees and learns a very interesting fact about Kotou’s ex…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: Make It and Eat It on Your Own
title.native: 自分で作って食べなさい。

189185.description:
“I’m asking you to break up with my father… immediately.” Ichihashi was happily in a relationship with Kaji, a man who’s much older than himself and the father of a family. The sudden appearance of Kaji’s son, Kyosuke, creates a rift in their relationship. Kyosuke certainly has his reasons for inserting himself between the two and demanding they break up. This is a story of three separate people, and a complicated web of feelings that collide into a crooked triangle of distorted emotions.

(Source: Local Manga)

Notes:
- Originally self-published, and was later collated by Shinshokan for print release on September 2, 2019.
- Includes an extra chapter.

189188.description:
Unremarkable and plain, high school student Touma is sleeping with his popular childhood friend, Yuusei. But—they are not lovers. At school, Yuusei acts like they’re strangers, refusing to even meet Touma’s eyes, as if he doesn’t want to be seen with him. Despite this, Touma, who harbors feelings for Yuusei, is happy to sleep with him. Yet, weighed down by the guilt of having hurt Yuusei in the past, he suppresses his emotions. However, one day, Yuusei suddenly and forcefully invites Touma on their first-ever date—!?

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: あした、嫌いになりたい

189189.description:
After 35 consecutive days of work, the exhausted manager of a karaoke bar injures himself in the kitchen. Just when he’s at his limit, part-timer Miyakawa-kun suddenly offers to help ******—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.
189189.hashtag: #バイトの宮川君は店長が好き

title.native: バイトの宮川君は店長が好き
title.romaji: Baito no Miyakawa-kun wa Tenchou ga Suki

189190.description:
Opportunity or crisis? U-Gyeong, as the new boss, is in charge of a team of incompetents. But worst of all is Gu Jeong-Ha, who has neither passion nor motivation. The only thing he knows how to do? Answer the phone! Will the new head of the brainteaser team be able to give work to the upstart who no-one dares to bother?

(Source: WEBTOONS, translated and edited)

title.native: ボクらはみんな生きてゆく!〜狩りと漫画の二足のわらじ篇〜
title.romaji: Bokura wa Minna Ikiteyuku!: Kari to Manga no Nisoku no Waraji-hen

189192.description:
Freedom is all our heroine wants, but that isn't what she finds when she is summoned across worlds into the body of Lady Beatrice and is newly named "Regria." As a "divine being" who can purify the minds of "divine knights," Regria is expected to wed the Belligram Empire's Prince Rahich, who only sees her as a tool that will keep him from going insane. But when Beatrice's original soul finds Regria in a moment of danger, she tells her how she can be free: by untangling Rahich's twisted soul and making him kneel at her feet.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 逃げれば、逃げるほどに
我在四个男人之间求生存

189193.description:
Hela, a world of relentless killing, war, violence, and murder.

Kang Hyuk awakened as a necromancer in this world. He did not know why or what had caused it. Was it because he had encountered death too many times?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: The Iron- Blooded Necromancer Has Returned

189194.description:
Seo-Yul Ji is a sex columnist with a secret—she’s still a virgin! She ends up befriending the popular actor Joo-Heon Kang, who agrees to provide her with a new viewpoint for her column. Her only condition is that they not sleep together. But as they grow closer, will she be able to resist his allure?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

189195.description:
When a man who looks straight out of a fantasy novel stumbles into her home, chef Yujeong sends him packing—but not before feeding him. After all, he was hungry, and a chef should never ignore a guy in need of grub. But the man comes back day after day, with one request for Yujeong: “Help me save my world!” Fateful words that send this humble chef on an adventure for the ages!

(Source: Tapas)

189196.description:
Seok-Jun only wanted one thing: peace and quiet. Tormented night after night by the nonstop sexcapades of his new neighbor, Ye-Chan, he reaches a breaking point and prays for the man’s “precious equipment” to disappear. The next morning, the moans are gone...and so is Ye-Chan’s manhood. Shocked by the eerie coincidence, Seok-Jun feels guilty enough to try to help…but Ye-Chan seems more interested in using him as a solution than finding one. What begins as a bizarre curse quickly spirals into a chaotic, heated romance between the man who wished it away and the man desperate to get it back.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: คำสาปวันกล้วยหาย

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 逆転の戦国編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Gyakuten no Sengoku-hen

189198.description:
Satomi, a university student who sweats excessively due to stress and anxiety, has just started dating his classmate Andou. What awaits them is a sweet and meltingly tender everyday life as lovers…!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 53, was then licensed by Shinshokan for digital release.

189199.description:
On a moonlit night, the lonely home-based programmer, Takigawa Makoto, picks up a small puppy. However, the next morning, the puppy has turned into a child...!?

Though shocked, when he talks to the child, Luka, who now has animal ears and a tail, was kidnapped and left on the street. Takigawa decides to take Luka in and protect him for a while. Soon after, Luka's father, the handsome but cocky Ookami Shirou, arrives to find him. Just as Takigawa thinks everything is fine, Shirou suddenly pushes him down—!?

(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)

189200.description:
Korean childcare worker Boyoung awakens in a mysterious land and a bygone era, trapped in the body of governess Edith Bruissel. Thrust into a world of secrets, magic, and noble intrigue, she is determined to find a mage who can send her home. But her plans are quickly complicated by a secretive duke with a troubled past, a marriage contract, and children who need her more than ever. Can Boyoung find her way back to the world she came from, or is she trapped in Edith’s life for good?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: There Are No Bad Golden Children in the World
There Are No Bad Precious Ones in the World

title.english: There's No Such Thing as a Naughty Munchkin

189201.description:
Arata Tsuchiya, a company employee, meets Ako Hino, a classmate from his high school days, and they end up spending a night together on the spur of the moment. Although both are curious about the other, the two have a casual and innocent love affair!

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

189202.description:
Jun-Su, a public health doctor serving his mandatory term at Songhwa Prison, thought his assignment would be dull, routine checkups, a few minor injuries, nothing more. But on his seventh day, the world literally collapses. A mysterious nationwide sinkhole disaster swallows cities whole, cutting the prison off from the outside world. Now trapped inside a fortress filled with men more terrifying than demons, Jun-Su has only one thought:

“I have to get out of here.”

Clutching a stolen keycard, his only ticket to freedom, he makes a break for it. But before he can escape, he runs into the infamous Lee brothers, Tae-Hyeong and Tae-Mu, cold-blooded criminals whose names alone strike fear even among inmates.

“What a feast. Lick it clean.”

With monsters above and monsters within, Jun-Su’s fight for survival turns into a chilling game of instinct, trust, and the brutal will to live.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189203.description:
"Seeing you writhe under me is super arousing." The beautiful fox demon, Natsume, has a hobby, and it's to play with humans by tricking them with his transformations! Today's target is a good-looking tailor, Takato. Even though Natsume invites him out of nowhere, Takato escorts him elegantly, and Natsume ends up getting drunk! When he woke up, he was at Takato's expensive apartment building. "I've never seen... such a sleek coat before." Natsume's sensitive ears and tail get teased, and with a deep kiss and gentle foreplay, he completely melts in Takato's arms...!!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: 讓我觸摸你色情的尾巴！～禽獸紳士的寵溺性愛～

title.english: Let Me Touch Your Sexy Tail! -Beastly Gentleman's Loving Sex-
title.native: えっちなしっぽ、触らせろ！～ケダモノ紳士の溺愛セックス
title.romaji: Ecchi na Shippo, Sawarasero!: Kedamono Shinshi no Dekiai Sex

189204.description:
All Yeon-Woo wanted was to befriend the cute underclassman sitting next to him in class. But when his friendly gesture is met with an icy glare, he's left baffled. Things only get worse: elevator doors slammed in his face, sticky notes slapped on his back… What is this, elementary school?! Fed up with the childish pranks, Yeon-Woo decides he’s had enough. But just as tensions peak - bam! They're assigned to the same group project. And in the middle of Yeon-Woo’s fury...he suddenly bursts into tears?! What does this kid have against Yeon-Woo, and what will Yeon-Woo have to do to make things right?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: [성비단 견공주의] 선배, 저 기억 안 나요?
[Seongbidan Gyeongongjuui] Seonbae, Jeo Gieok An Nayo?
[Mr. Blue BL Short Stories] Dogism: Seonbae, Don't You Remember Me?

189205.description:
In my past life, I was Soonjung Lee, but I died from overwork. When I awoke in the novel I’m Choosing the Sub Male Lead in This Life!, I swore that I wouldn't suffer again--I'd get rich and live as I pleased! But the side character I transmigrated into, Penelope, is nothing more than the widowed baroness of a poor territory. I need to do better--I must become wealthy! But, unfortunately, to reach my goal I'll need the lord of the magic tower's help, and he’s not exactly the nicest guy...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Don't Know the Original, I'm Busy Making a Living

title.english: I Couldn't Care Less About the Original, I'm Just Trying to Survive

189206.description:
Hiding behind an invisible mask, he takes on different identities, making money with his sleight of hand and silver tongue. One day, as he sets out to swindle yet another wealthy target—

"You're lying, aren't you?"

He encounters Chronica, a girl with a left eye that can read and manipulate the souls of others. Seeing through his deception, she not only robs him of all his wealth but also blackmails him into traveling with her. Determined to outwit her—and, more importantly, to reclaim his fortune—Linus uses every trick at his disposal to navigate a perilous journey filled with danger and challenges.

At the end of their road, what awaits them is the truth behind Chronica’s secret… and the deception Linus has been hiding all along.

A modern supernatural fantasy road movie—let the journey begin!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Winner of the Grand Prize in the 19th MF Bunko J Light Novel Rookie Award.

title.native: マスカレード・コンフィデンス 詐欺師は少女と仮面仕掛けの旅をする
title.romaji: Masquerade Confidence: Sagishi wa Shoujo to Kamen Shikake no Tabi wo Suru

189207.description:
Kohaku Samejima works as a resident doctor at Usagi Children's Hospital. He aspired to become a pediatrician because he wanted to make children smile, but the children's hospital is full of crying faces everywhere. Naturally, the hospital prioritizes the future smiles of children who will be cured, not the present while they are undergoing treatment. Samejima, who still cannot give up on the "smiles of today" of children in such a field, meets Shio Tokita, a child life specialist (CLS) who specializes in the care of children's mental health.

(Source: Coamix, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: チャイルドリリーバー 宇左木こども病院の時田さん
title.romaji: Child Reliever: Usagi Kodomo Byouin no Tokita-san

189208.description:
Haru, is a stray cat who got picked up by a beautiful lady. After happily going home with her, he sees another cat, Rui, who is bigger and cooler than him! Haru, who sees Rui as a rival, says, "I will never get along with you!", But Rui just chuckles softly. One day, Haru, who had gotten shots at the hospital, suddenly gets a fever. He's thirsty, dizzy, and his penis aches...!! While Haru's body is in heat, the feeling of Rui's large hand is so nice—!? Popular virtual character streamer Keita has been searching for someone important to him—someone who vanished three years ago—while continuing his streaming activities. One day, he finds himself harassed by a group of strangers, only to be saved by a man with a voice he recognizes instantly. “This guy is mine,” the man declares—and to Keita’s shock, it’s none other than his long-lost childhood friend, Yasuna! Yasuna had moved to the U.S. due to family circumstances but returned because he wanted to see Keita again. As they reconnect, they realize their feelings for each other have always been mutual, and their hearts and bodies draw closer at an overwhelming pace.

Once a year on a cold midwinter night in the Empire of Hartan, a fortress of frost appears, revealing the resting place of a blue-eyed demon said to grant any wish – for a price. When Princess Estelle of Hartan flees her abusive imperial family, she is encounters the otherworldly Frost Fort and makes a pact with Satael, the blue-eyed demon of legend. Everyone knows the tale of a poor girl, abused by step-sisters and helped by her fairy godmother. Stella knows the story well, but she finds herself reincarnated as a wicked stepsister-the classic villainess role! Rather than playing along, Stella tries to befriend Cinderella instead!

Aki Kurumi, 29 years old, meets Shisui Amakusa at a singles' mixer, and what should he unexpectedly propose but a paper marriage...!
