189264.description:
Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: จอมเวทนอกรีตแห่งหอคอยขาว

189265.description:
Reborn with memories she never asked for, Jian Song wants nothing more than a quiet, ordinary life. But everything changes when she meets him again—the man she once loved beyond reason, and the one who shattered her. No matter how hard she tries to stay away, fate keeps pulling them together in ways she never expected. As her new life begins to mirror the tragic patterns of her past, she must face one question: can she rewrite her story this time, or is she doomed to repeat it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

189266.description:
In a world where ordinary people possess superpowers, becoming a superhero is no longer an unattainable dream. However, for him, who lacks superpowers but aspires to be a hero, he can only embark on the path of cultivating immortality. You have superpowers, so what? With immortal magic, saving the world only requires the wave of a finger!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: No More Pretending, I'm Stronger Than Superheroes
Do I Have a Screw Lose in My Head for Cultivating in a World of Superpowers?
Who Am I? I Am the Strongest Hero
非能力者だが俺は仙道でヒーローを目指す

title.english: Chosen to be Immortal in the World of Superpower
title.romaji: Bu Zhuang le, Wo Bi Yingxiong Huan Qiang

189267.description:
Hong Dal-Gi, the detective who lost everything due to one mistake, Yu-Jin, a violent detective who receives disciplinary action as if it were a meal, and an elite informant who graduated at the top of his class at the police academy. These three detectives who do not get along at all form a team and gradually become one as they solve cases.

(Source: Naver, translated)

189268.description:
Three years ago, the Emperor Alliance was disbanded. The gaming prodigy Mo Bei retired quietly. Three years later, the prodigy returned crossed-dressing as a man and hiding his identity. She once again stepped back up onto the altar from a state of shame, drawing the cheers of everyone! He was handsome and had no time for love. He had countless fans, and everyone knew him in the eSports industry. He then said to her when she first joined the team, “Keep your head down, and don’t try to take things that you don’t deserve.” When her identity was revealed, he looked at her from behind his desk and stood up.

“You want to abandon me just like that when we just got married ingame? Hm?”

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: The Ace has a Secret Crush on Me

189270.description:
One day, high schooler Makoto discovers a mysterious red number "222" on his pinky finger. Visible only to him, the number decreases by one each day. What fate awaits him when the countdown hits zero?

(Source: Manga Plus)

189271.description:
Let's be together forever. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2015-12

title.native: 淫乱OL 沢渡登喜子～女達の淫靡な素顔～
title.romaji: Inran OL Sawatari Tokiko: Onna-tachi no Inbi na Sugao

189276.description:
A monster that eats people, takes away their appearance and memory, and replaces them, " Werewolf". Wolves are integrated into human society, and they prolong their lives by eating people so that they cannot be understood by their surroundings. Someone who was close to me yesterday may be a fake today. When the fate of such a monster and the young man who "gostain" of "life" intersects, a strange story begins.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Werewolf Who Wants to Stay Alive

189277.description:
In a world where the secondary sexes of Dom and Sub exist...

Office worker Shino is aware that he doesn't even make the cut for the lowest tier of the Sub population, which wrecks his confidence and makes it hard for him to find a partner. One day, he happens to run into Triple S―tier Dom and super hot model Aoha, whose mesmerizing gaze causes Shino to faint right on the spot. The two test out their physical chemistry strictly as a means to take care of their health, and Aoha's commands resonate throughout Shino's entire body. After a wild night where they both lose themselves to pleasure, they decide to continue their arrangement... Perhaps love really can blossom from dominating and being dominated...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ブラットテイマー／キング
黒の歌姫 -ヤミノエニシ-
title.romaji: Kuro no Utahime: Yami no Enishi

title.native: おもいあい♥モノポライズ
君とブルーに染まる頃
title.romaji: Kimi to Blue ni Somaru Koro

189281.description:
"In 24 hours, you will die.” One day, the Grim Reaper appears in front of Taira, a junior in college. Will Taira be able to make the most of the limited time left in his life?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

189282.description:
Kugimoto Iroha has appeared on several Shouwa Saishuu Sensen doujins and now we have her origin story.

We already know she's a massive perverted masochist, but now we see how she got there~

(Source: Fakku!)

title.native: 変態お便女クロニクル

189284.description:
In 2054, when only 40% of the population has survived due to a crisis caused by humans, the entire planet agrees to a 'Regenerative Human Era' where the environment is the absolute top priority. Half a century later, in a society where all pursuit of individuality, including fashion other than daily necessities, is not only forbidden but sinful, five reckless middle school students, each with their own reasons for wanting to be fashionable, come together to form a 'Secret Fashion Club...! The wild fashion story of brave middle school students!

(Source: Naver, translated)

189285.description:
I have to defeat the great monster! ???: I'm 8 years old? An exorcism boys' manga featuring the cute and soft priestess Sea and the gloomy exorcist Shio!

(Source: Naver, translated)

189286.description:
"How nice it would be if I could just sleep soundly for one day without thinking about anything."

Kim Ga-Hee, a nurse who is exhausted from her current life due to excessive work stress and who spends her days listless without a single person close to her, lost her memories of nearly five years due to a sudden accident. The problem is that she seems to have had a boyfriend.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: A Woman Who Lost 4 Years and 6 Months

189287.description:
The cheerful and handsome Shion and the seemingly cool but secretly a fudanshi, Sota, have become a couple and are happily (and sometimes intimately) spending time together. However, one day, Shion unexpectedly says, "I want to introduce you to my mom." Sota, who hasn’t yet come out to anyone about his relationship with Shion, struggles with what to do next—what should he say? His internal conflict deepens as he tries to figure out how to handle the situation.

(Source: Homesha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 続!!腐男子くんには秘密がある
title.romaji: Zoku!! Fudanshi-kun ni wa Himitsu ga Aru

189288.description:
Rai has been secretly crushing on her childhood friend Do-Gyeong for years. To hide her feelings, she pretends to be a die-hard fan of the K-pop group DIMPLE, especially of Neulchan, her "ultimate bias." It's all just fun and games to make Do-Gyeong a little jealous... until Neulchan suddenly transfers to her school. With her fake idol crush now a real part of her life, her friendship with Do-Gyeong starts to spiral. One fake crush, and one real crush—can Rai keep up the act, or is her secret about to come out?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

189291.description:
Li Hao discovered that his family and friends around him died one after another according to the order mentioned in the lyrics of an old ballad, and that he would be the next one to die! As he delves deeper into his investigation, everything appears to be related to the ancient ruins of Constellation Door, where supernatural abilities were awakened decades ago...

(Source: Webnovel)

189292.description:
Imari Shuuya (26) works at a high school with a strict new policy: “In-school romance is forbidden—break this rule and you’re fired.” As a serious professional, he figures teachers shouldn’t be wasting time on love when they have students to look after anyway. But his convictions are shaken when the school’s new and strikingly handsome nurse, Yotsumi Rio (22), begins pursuing him with alarming devotion!

A cat-and-mouse BL romance between a straight-laced, bespectacled teacher and the yandere school nurse who’s determined to make him fall!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Notes:
- Originally published as a one-shot on Gangan Online, was then picked up for serialization.
- During serialization, Chapters 2, 11, and 12 were split into two parts while Chapters 3 to 10 and 13 were split into three parts. These were all combined in the volume releases.
- Includes 10 extra chapters.

189293.description:
"Please, do not leave me."

"We should get a divorce. You don't love me, do you? We... only got married for our families' sake."

"Why… Why are you saying such things? Did I do something wrong to you? If you want me to kneel, I will. If you don’t like my face, I will wear a mask for the rest of my life. So, please… please, do not leave my side."

My husband, whom I married through an arranged marriage, is the second male lead who harbors an unrequited love for the heroine of The Saintess’ Wish, the novel I have possessed. And I, his lawful wife, am destined to endure a lonely marriage before meeting a mysterious death. For my own survival—and for his love—I decided to cleanly end our marriage. But…

"Why is he holding onto me? Aren’t you supposed to love Aria???"

"This novel’s world… is different from what I knew. What is the truth?"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Ugly Wife of the Shady Duke

189294.description:
It's your fault for being deceived...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2015-10

189296.description: It is now Cosmic Era (C.E.) 75, two years after the dismantlement of the Destiny Plan, but warfare still continues to rage on between Naturals and Coordinators. Independence movements are now sprouting up across Earth, and invasions by Blue Cosmos grow exponentially stronger... To deal with these predicaments, a World Peace Supervision Organization known as COMPASS has been established, with PLANT Chairwoman Lacus Clyne as the founding leader. Kira Yamato and the others, as its new members, intervene into various battles for the sake of this peace. However, as these battles take place, an emergent nation known as 'FOUNDATION' appears, and they propose a joint operation to attack the Blue Cosmos Headquarters. Will Destiny run its course, or will Kira still have the Freedom to resist against impossible odds?

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM

189297.description:
Nina Kamisato is a corporate drone, always heading home on the last train. But one night, when she's about to eat her late dinner, she's suddenly transported to another world (along with her rice cooker) as part of a saintess summoning ritual. Unfortunately, her beautiful, young neighbor ends up being summoned along with her and is immediately assumed to be the true saintess. Thus, Nina is banished from the royal capital.

Alone in an unknown world with nothing other than her rice cooker, what's a girl to do?! As she tries to wrap her head around what had just ensued, a puppy-like creature then appears before her... An adorable, heartwarming tale of an overworked woman turned exiled saintess, her handsome Sacred Beast companion, and their leisurely adventures traveling and cooking.
synonyms: I'm a Saintess Who Was Exiled, so My Fluffy Servant (Holy Beast) and I Make Onigiri

title.english: I Was Exiled for Supposedly Not Being the Saintess and Now I Make Rice Balls with My Fluffy (Sacred Beast) Servant
title.native: 聖女じゃないと追放されたので、もふもふ従者（聖獣）とおにぎりを握る
title.romaji: Seijo ja Nai to Tsuihou Sareta node, Mofumofu Juusha (Seijuu) to Onigiri wo Nigiru

189299.description: In a world where humans battle monsters, the skilled Saint Sia is tasked to defeat the Demon King but finds herself labeled incompetent and banished from the Hero's party. But instead of despairing, she's actually thrilled! This is her chance to meet truly wonderful and top-notch companions! Determined to build a guild that values character over strength, she seeks out her ideal party members. Her recruits are a mix of odd yet charming individuals: a sincere and hardworking young man living as a vagrant, an endearingly naive little girl, and a clumsy older man—ordinary folk notable only for their kindness. With her Saintly powers, Sia recognizes their hidden talents and helps them flourish through quests. Though still rough around the edges, they might just become strong enough to take on the Demon King! With the resourceful guild leader by their side, perhaps they can become something more.
synonyms: I Was Fired From the Saints and Heroes Party and Created a Guild, and It Has Grown Into the Strongest Guild Like My Home
성녀, 용사 파티에서 해고 당해 길드를 만들었더니 내 집 같은 최강의 길드로 성장했습니다
The Saint Fired From the Hero's Party Created a Guild at Home, and It Grew Into the Strongest Guild
I, a Saint, Was Dismissed from the Hero Party; Therefore, I Established a Guild, Which Grew up to Be the Strongest One Having a Homey Atmosphere @comic

title.native: 聖女、勇者パーティーから解雇されたのでギルドを作ったらアットホームな最強ギルドに育ちました。@COMIC
title.romaji: Seijo, Yuusha Party kara Kaiko Sareta node Guild wo Tsukuttara Atto Home na Saikyou Guild ni Sodachimashita。 @COMIC

189300.description:
A humble chemistry teacher loses his life in an unfortunate accident and is reincarnated as Roca, a farmer in a fantasy world. Roca has an adorable and devoted wife named Arc, but he is a textbook hopeless man who borrows money from Arc to gamble. Roca, who falls in love with Arc at first sight, uses his innate chemistry knowledge and the given "purification skill" to solve all kinds of problems in order to make Arc smile. Gradually, his activities catch the eye of the royal nobility, and he gets caught up in an interstate war... [Credits] Original Story: Hiroki Nosuka, Name: Shake no. Marinade, Character Design/Line Art: Doya, Divine Beast Design: Unamiso, Background Production/Coloring/Finishing: Inaho Inc., Scientific Supervision: Katsunori Sato, Production: Minto Studio

(Source: Mangadex)

title.romaji: Aisaika Sugiru Scientist wa Kyuukoku no Eiyuu ni Naru

189301.description:
The real me is extremely perverted. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2015-10

title.native: なりきりエッチ 美翔ちゃん

189302.description:
One day, while walking on the beach, an old man and his dog Fujio came across a baby mermaid. He named it Aki-chan, but the old man had lost his wife early and had no children, so he knew nothing about raising a child. And what's more, it was a baby mermaid! He didn't know what to feed it or even how mermaids lived! So begins the old man's struggle to raise the mermaid on his own!!

(source: Kodansha, translated)

189303.description: I'm Amiru, a Reiwa-era gal who loves anything that gets me super hyped☆ I used to hate myself. but thanks to a kind Heisei-era gal onee-san, I learned to love who I am♪ From giving a strict morals committee guy a makeover and finding out he's actually pretty hot, to blowing up on social media... all sorts of crazy things happen, but with full gal power, I’m living every day fired up and having a blast!

title.native: イイネ！ＲＥＩＷＡギャル★あみるん

189305.description:
Lee Chul-Joong, a team leader in the Jae-Young faction, isn’t thrilled about the arrival of a new director from the entertainment industry. What could someone like that possibly know about "real" business? But when Chul-Joong meets the director for the first time—while secretly carrying drugs in his person—things take an unexpected turn. In a twist of fate, he strikes the deal of a lifetime with Director Choi Ha-Gyeong, the perfect deal that could either destroy him or completely turn his world upside down.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

189306.description:
A poor commoner chatterbox accidentally entered the celebrity high school and the unthinkable happened…?

Notes:
- Includes the one-shot "Onna Kyoushi wa 16-sai. (女教師は16歳。)".
- Includes the one-shot "Mouai♥Idol!! (妄愛♥アイドル!!)".
synonyms: The Lying Prince's Game of Pretending To Be a Couple

title.native: 嘘つき王子のカレカノごっこ

189307.description:
"Jae-Hee, why do you always carry two copies of your script?" "Well, you might lose them."

That's a lie. One is for carrying around to the filming set and showing it to others. The other is. [The drama 'Youth Train' can be absorbed.] [Would you like to absorb it?] It is for my own consumption. I devour the script and make it mine alone. The story of Jae-Hee, an actor who can absorb a script 100%.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

189308.description:
Saal Cooper was the perfect "shadow" of the Cooper family. He was loyal, powerful, and... expendable. Spellbound to be Eren Cooper's human shield, Saal took all the wounds and pain meant for his master, making him an invincible hero. When the family discards him like a broken tool, Saal discovers the horrifying truth behind his lifelong agony. Betrayed and left to die, he reverses the spell with his final breath, reclaiming his stolen power. But death grants him an unexpected gift when he is reborn as his three-year-old self. This time, Saal is determined not to live in the shadows.

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: Rules For Getting Along With the Vicious Dog Husband

title.native: 和恶犬丈夫的相处法则
title.romaji: He E Quan Zhangfu De Xiangchu Faze

189310.description:
Ciella Leroix reincarnated into a story she read in her past life. Although her name and backstory resemble that of Cinderella, she is not the main character in this story. She spent most of her life being mistreated by her family, and she was almost sold off into marriage until a handsome duke struck a deal with her. After years of distrusting others, she opens up to him only to have her hope shattered once again. Ciella soon realizes that the only way for her to be happy… is to disappear.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: ซินเดอเรลล่าที่หายไป
シンデレラにお別れを

189311.description:
The hometown of Miharu's missing mother was a beach village with a torii gate facing the sea. As the once-in-60-years grand festival to choose Ozan approaches, Miharu decides to go to the island of the shrine!

(source: KManga, translated)

189312.description:
Inside a trap known as salvation...

(Source: FAKKU!)

Published in COMIC X-EROS ＃72.

189313.description:
"Time keeps rewinding to one month before my divorce...!?" Will this hopeless husband, completely unaware of his crumbling family, realize his mistakes and escape from the time loop...!?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: エンドレス離婚～もしも結婚生活をやり直せたなら～
title.romaji: Endless Rikon - Moshimo Kekkon Seikatsu wo Yarinaosetanara

189314.description:
One fateful night, Sung-Hoon, a music professor, and his family suffer a devastating accident. While their son, Hyun-Woo, escapes relatively unscathed, his parents are not so lucky. Months later, Sung-Hoon wakes up. It turns out, his perfect life wasn’t quite so perfect. Will he finally escape his wife’s control? Or does Hyun-Woo have his own plans for his father?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

189315.description:
One sunny day day, a portal burst open in the garden, and Kwon Jae-Jin got caught up in the chaos. His limbs were torn off, and he died...

…Or so he thought.

When he wakes up, he finds himself back on the first day of his captivity—with Seo Wui-Wu between his legs, tugging at his pants. Jae-Jin stares down at the familiar face, one he had come to resent over the four agonizing years of his previous life. Back then, he had believed he was merely a victim, dragged into an unfamiliar place and forced into submission. But this time is different. Now, Jae-Jin knows exactly how Seo Wui-Wu thinks, what moves him, and—most importantly—how to control him. With the promise of guiding as bait, Seo Wui-Wu will be his to manipulate. As Seo Wui-Wu’s breath grows heavy and his dark hair falls messily over his forehead, his hungry gaze flashes with dangerous excitement. Who will truly hold the reins in this second chance at fate?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: My Second Chance on Taming an Obsessed Esper
Unrivaled Samurai: The Strongest Samurai of the Sengoku Period Conquers Another World

title.native: サムライ無双～戦国最強のサムライ、異世界を征く～
title.romaji: Samurai Musou: Sengoku Saikyou no Samurai, Isekai wo Seiku

189317.description:
Kang Oh-Hyun, who pretended to be heterosexual and appeared on the dating variety show . But his first one-night stand partner was the main PD of the program! The main PD, Jeong-Wook, gave Oh-Hyun a harsh scolding for appearing on the program while hiding the fact that he was gay…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Blühen's Ssasek Danpyeonseon (싸섹 단편선) Collection.

189318.description:
It was a beautiful mermaid who saved me...

We have only one wish. I want to be with you forever... But God won't even grant that wish...?

"I'll always believe and wait for the day I can see you again." I live in a port town with a beautiful sea view. I'm happy every day surrounded by my childhood friend Nagi and the kind people of the town. But I have a dream that I really want to make come true. It's to be reunited with a "certain boy." Seven years ago, that boy with a beautiful face who saved me from drowning in the sea had the form of a mermaid... But even so, I want to see you one more time. And then, a mermaid appears before me...

Where will my fate lead to with the mermaid boy...?

(source: Shogakukan Comic, translated)

189320.description:
Introverted and overly self-conscious, Aizawa secretly admires his café coworker, Risa. But no matter how hard he tries, he just can’t express his feelings.
Enter the café manager, Rion—who completely ignores Aizawa’s feelings and throws him into one unexpected situation after another!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

189321.description:
Having fulfilled his childhood dream, Kashino Yūki finally debuts as a rookie voice actor. His greatest wish? To perform alongside his childhood friend, Kōsaka Izumi, who is three years older and already a successful, well-known voice actor. Determined to catch up to Izumi, Yūki puts in relentless effort—until one day, his dream comes true. They are cast together in a project… But the job is a BL drama CD, a genre Yūki has no experience with. Struggling with his role and feeling discouraged, he confesses, "I just can’t seem to imagine what ‘pleasure’ sounds like…" To which Izumi, ever the helpful senior, suggests a hands-on lesson…!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: たいへんよく鳴けました

189322.description:
Shiba Tsukasa is a manga artist who has been dating his childhood friend and senior editor, Kazuto, for six months. Having only experienced immature romance in the past, Tsukasa enjoys how Kazuto showers him with kisses and affection every day. However, for some reason, Kazuto refuses to take things all the way. Tsukasa longs to catch up to an adult romance, but Kazuto keeps treating him like a child…
One day, Tsukasa accidentally meets Kazuto’s ex, a man with a mature aura. Doubt creeps in—Am I not enough for him…?

(Source: Hobunsha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: かまってほしい志羽先生

189324.description:
Childhood friends and inseparable best friends, Katsumi and Minoru are the center of attention at their high school. Their striking looks, constant togetherness, and excessive physical affection have sparked rumors that they’re dating.
The truth is, Katsumi secretly harbors romantic feelings for Minoru. It’s obvious that Minoru considers Katsumi special, but his affection is a confusing mix of familial love, friendship, and desire—something fundamentally different from romance.
Understanding this, Katsumi struggles to restrain himself, refusing to cross the line between friendship and something more.
However, their delicate balance is suddenly shattered one day—and everything changes…!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: エモーション・コントローラー
ヴァルナ・コレクション

189328.description:
Kaname is an ordinary high schooler who has a crush on his perfect classmate, Nobuharu, who is handsome, intelligent, and good at both academics and sports.
His daily routine is to watch over him (= stalk him).
One day, when he was happy just looking at him, Nobuharu said, "You might be my destined partner", and locked on to him, eating him!?
A carnivorous school prince who believes in fate x a devoted, crying, brave stalker. A heart-pounding, devoted high schooler love story.

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Maicchingu Unmei (まいっちんぐ運命)".
- Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 運命は覗き見してたらヤッてきた

189329.description:
Now that they’ve successfully made it back home safe and sound, Yogiri, Tomochika, and the surviving members of their class begin the long work of readjusting to life in their own world. But even with their story finished, countless mysteries remain to be explored! This collection of short stories answers all sorts of questions left unanswered by the main series. What was Hanakawa’s previous adventure like? Who is Haruto Ootori, and why does he have wings? Just what has (the real) Enju been up to since we last saw her in the underground facility? There are plenty of answers to be found in over ten stories...and maybe another mystery or two to ponder!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: My Instant Death Ability Is So Overpowered, No One in This Other World Stands a Chance Against Me! After Story
title.native: 即死チートが最強すぎて、異世界のやつらがまるで相手にならないんですが。〈後始末篇〉

title.romaji: Toshishita no Josei Kyoukan ni Kyou mo Shikatte Itadaketa

title.native: 幼馴染とえっちで仲直り

189336.description:
Why not unwind in another world once in a while? High schooler Kudo Akira happens upon the ability to travel between Japan and the fantastical world of Do-Melta. Not bound by any dire mission or duty, he leisurely enjoys exploring his way through the massive dungeon in the center of the world and all the trappings that come with it. The guild receptionist is trying to mooch off of him, his magic instructor has “rewards” for him, and he just might have some fun with a girl he saves... A brand-new fantasy adventure from Hitsuji Gamei begins!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

189338.description:
Hayato, an alpha, has been grappling with a problem for years. That is, his older childhood friend and fated omega partner, Riichi, won't do anything more than kiss him due to the rule: "No excessive touching!"

Nine years ago, when Hayato was still a kid, he bit Riichi on the nape of the neck while they were roughhousing, accidentally making them a fated pair. As a result, Riichi made him promise not to cross a certain line with him until he turned 20. With one year left, Hayato is determined to get Riichi, who keeps treating him like a younger brother, to love him back. Unfortunately, all of his attempts have ended in failure... Or so he thinks! One day, when Hayato caresses Riichi gently with his hands, Riichi's reason begins to crumble...

189339.description:
Kaito Irie—an unremarkable young man without even hobbies to speak of—has been killed thanks to a goddess’s careless mistake. As recompense, he is offered the chance to continue living in a new world with not just one newfound passion to guide and fulfill him, but three: “Collection,” “Animal Ears,” and “Laser Beams.” But with everything looking too good to be true, Kaito can’t help but wonder...is there a catch? Using his new god-given power to fire a beam powerful enough to smite any foe and precise enough to replace any tool, Kaito becomes an adventurer in search of riches and glory. Along the way, he tirelessly helps the oppressed, half-animal, half-human hybrids that inhabit his new home. Is it out of the goodness of his heart...or out of a desire to get closer to their irresistibly adorable animal ears?! Here unfolds the epic tale of a typical, run-of-the-mill guy who just happens to wield a peerless beam of death!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Minami Chihiro has a rare condition—when exhaustion and stress pile up, he develops a fever... and goes into heat. Now in college, he reunites with his old classmate, Shishiou, who aggressively pursues him. Back in middle school, Shishiou once taught Chihiro how to jerk off, and to keep that a secret, Chihiro agreed to a deal: "I'll go on 10 dates with you."

Grocery shopping together, cooking meals, hanging out at cafés… Before he knows it, Chihiro finds himself getting swept up in Shishiou's pace—!?

Born as the son of a wealthy family, Jang Geon was destined for ruin. To turn his fate around, he had to live a simple life under the guidance of a virtuous monk. Given to the frugal monk Gyeongmok at Shaolin Temple, Jang Geon spent his days in rough cotton robes, barely getting by on plain rice... While enduring hunger and minimizing movement in his daily life, he stumbled upon martial arts and managed to apply his mindset of thrift to it...?

189351.description:
Prince Callus Leditzweissen is a Taboo Being, an unfortunate soul born with a deadly curse that causes him constant suffering. With no known cure, the doctors say Callus only has six months left to live. But a magician named Gourley gives the boy a sliver of hope when he demonstrates the healing power of light magic. Callus is determined to learn how to use light magic in time to save himself, hoping to live longer to repay all the kindness he's been shown throughout his life.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

The series follows genius surgeon Akira Kirihara, who is suddenly reborn as Chiara Bellworth, the protagonist of "Cinderella's Engagement." In this world, all wounds are healed by magic, and those whose injuries cannot be healed are abandoned. Kiara comes to the medical aid of Prince Cecil's follower. Impressed with her power, he proposes to her in hopes of reforming the country's medical system.

(Source: Anime News Network)

189355.description:
There’s a price to be paid for a seemingly perfect life. For Raven, the dashing young son of a duke tasked with guarding the empire, marriage represents nothing but a downward spiral into misery. Cherishing his freedom as a bachelor, Raven is perplexed when the daughter of rival House Sharen makes him a daring proposal of marriage. But there’s a hitch: Lady Estrella Sharen is an infamous villainess who is feared across the empire! Raven suspects there is more to her than meets the eye, but nonetheless agrees to enter into a marriage contract…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I can't stop doting on the most evil woman in the empire!

189356.description:
There’s a convenience store that feels uncomfortable but somehow keeps drawing you in. One day, a new night-shift part-timer appears at the small convenience store -- his rugged looks fill everyone with unease, but soon he brings about a refreshing change to this small convenience store. He helps not only his coworkers but also customers, resolving their worries and troubles. Who is this mysterious night-shift part-timer?

(Source: WEBTOON)

189357.description:
Gang-In Na wakes up in the year 2024 in the middle of South Korea with no memory of where or who he is. Upon hearing a voice that sounds strangely familiar, he comes face to face with a robot named ACE (Autonomous Combat Entity), who informs him that he was once part of the Earth Federation Forces in the year 2082 and possesses a wide array of skills. Gang-In decides to join forces with ACE to recover his lost memories and adapt to life on Earth, but the two look to be in for a bumpy ride.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: A Hero Who Does Everything Perfectly
A Hero Who Is Good At Everything

189358.description:
Monsters pour out of gates, wreaking havoc on the world, but Tae-Jun couldn’t care less. After seven years of failure and bullying in his hunter’s guild, he’s fired—until his dormant S-Tier power suddenly activates. Now, with newfound strength, Tae-Jun hunts monsters, exacts brutal revenge, and rises to fame. But as his power grows, so does the danger, and shadowy forces begin targeting him. Can Tae-Jun stay one step ahead and crush those who want him dead?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: My Status Window Is On Strike

title.english: My Status Window Went on Strike

189359.description:
"You guys use fists, not guns!"

Shin Hae-Soo, a specialist in excessive suppression, gains the ability to go back 60 minutes. On the day my father passed away, I intuitively knew. This was a murder disguised as suicide. Hae-Soo becomes a detective to catch the culprit who killed his father. And one day, along with a mysterious accident, he suddenly gains superpowers! A huge shadow gradually reveals itself as he solves criminal cases and pursues the organization!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

189360.description:
The academy where Amon was assigned as a new teacher has gone bankrupt! The principal is addicted to gambling, the teachers are no-goods, and the students are lethargic! How will Amon tread forth as he stands at the crossroads of escape and success? A comedic fantasy series that will make your sides hurt from laughing!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seon-U Kang, a high school student, single-handedly takes down a group of illegal loan sharks who show up at his house. While being treated at the hospital, he encounters a mysterious man who offers him an invitation to a suspicious secret fighting tournament with a massive cash prize. The prize money is his only hope to save his family. Seon-U must survive in the combat ward at all costs! Will he be able to defeat all other fighters and become champion?

(Source: WEBTOON)

189364.description:
Ever since falling ill as a child, Mel Slofi has had white hair. However, this trait brings her more than she bargained for when it leads her to be mistaken for the lost daughter of a duke-- even being told by the duke’s son to keep up the facade in order to protect his fragile father. But when Mel sees a mysterious woman at a grand ball who perfectly matches the photos she’s seen of the duke’s real daughter, she begins to worry that the truth may be catching up to her.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: The Day the Real One Appeared

189369.description:
Shino, an average office worker, somehow ended up dating Aoha, an ultra-rare SSS-rank Dom—practically an urban legend. With Aoha being a top model, syncing their schedules is tough, and they barely get to see each other. Living together would solve that… and maybe even lead to something more…? As Aoha’s overwhelming affection intensifies, their honeymoon phase only deepens their bond.

(Source: Taiyohtosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ブラットテイマー／キング engage!

189370.description:
On his first wedding anniversary, office worker Hiura returns home—only to walk in on his wife cheating.
What follows is a messy, drawn-out ordeal, but with the help of Sugaya, a former high school underclassman turned lawyer, the divorce is finalized.
Finally free, Hiura enjoys a long-overdue drink with Sugaya, but on the way home, he suddenly has a flashback and ends up throwing up. Unable to return to the scene of the betrayal, he’s been crashing at internet cafés, and to make matters worse, he awkwardly admits, "I... can't get it up anymore."
Concerned, Sugaya offers, "Why don’t you stay at my place?"—and from there, everything begins to change…

(Source: Leed Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: バッドルームセラピー

189371.description:
Izumi, a dedicated music student, worked tirelessly to get into a prestigious conservatory. But fate has a cruel sense of humor—his longtime rival, Yona, is now his classmate. Once the very person who defeated him in past competition, Yona is a prodigy, praised as a rising star on the international piano scene. Fueled by quiet resentment, Izumi seizes a chance to show off his skills during a lecture. To his surprise, instead of dismissing him, Yona makes an unexpected offer: "Be my duet partner." And so, their tumultuous campus life begins—!?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

189372.description:
Negura works at an app development company and absolutely hates his boss, Tai.
Tai is effortlessly competent, good-looking, and always seems to overshadow him, fueling Negura’s inferiority complex. But the most irritating thing of all? Tai’s secret—he's a top-ranked top on a dating app exclusively for men.
Unable to stop himself from imagining what his insufferable boss is like at night, Negura spends his days in frustrated turmoil.
One day, after a work blunder leaves him seething, Negura finally snaps and pins Tai down. Seeing his usually composed boss flushed with shame and pleasure… he can’t hold back his excitement!

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: マッチングリバーサルメーカー

189378.description:
In a world torn between light and darkness, Juniper, a lowly soldier in the Demon King's army, receives an impossible task. To mentor the fallen hero! As an unlikely bond forms between them, their connection may reshape the very fabric of their divided realm. An epic high fantasy adventure where heaven and earth collide!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189379.description:
Welcome to "Octet," the one and only host club in Nara Prefecture... but this is no ordinary establishment! Their clientele? None other than goddesses themselves! Experience a modern-day host club fantasy like no other!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189380.description:
The world has ended. I was a genius hero, but my efforts were too little, too late—I couldn’t stop the Blood Demon Emperor. As I died, I prayed for a second chance... but this isn't what I meant! Of all people, I’ve become Christian, a rogue member of the House of Dark Demons. As if that wasn’t enough, the world is still ending in just five years. There's only one way to save it: I must become the emperor myself and stop the war! I know it sounds ridiculous, but I’m a genius—I can make it work!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Genius Bastard of a Noble Dark Clan

title.english: The Unorthodox Genius of the House of Darkness

189381.description:
Akira is eager to get laid, but he doesn't want a boyfriend nor does he want to do it with a complete stranger. One day, when he tries to break things off with his no-strings-attached partner who developed romantic feelings for him, the guy desperately clings onto him in public, begging him not to leave. Coincidentally, Akira's former student from back when he was a student teacher sees him in trouble and saves the day! Akira is thrilled to be reunited with Tadayasu, who's as good-looking as Akira remembers him in high school, and convinces him, rather forcibly, to stay the night at his house... The more Akira gets to know Tadayasu, the more he becomes infatuated with the charming younger straight guy! However, Akira is reluctant to make a move on Tadayasu, who's technically still in his teens... So, can he hurry up and grow up already!?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter
189381.hashtag: #あともうすこしで恋なのに！
synonyms: Just a Little More, and It Would Be Love!

title.native: あともうすこしで恋なのに！
title.romaji: Ato Mou Sukoshi de Koi Nanoni!

189382.description:
Yeong-won, who once again failed to secure a full professorship, gets drunk in a fit of rage and ends up sleeping with Ui-hyeon, her closest friend. Yeong-won soon discovers that she can only escape the pressure of her professorship when having sex. She then spends a passionate night with her colleague, Louis, who suggests that Yeong-won use Ui-hyeon for a...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

189384.description:
With her beauty, power, and the position of empress, Vionne Rosa Ellient seemingly had everything one could want. But in truth, she endlessly yearned for love before ultimately dying in misery. Now, after waking up again as her younger self, Vionne calmly assesses her situation and past memories to avoid marrying Crown Prince Sirius and meeting the same fate. As different choices lead to a change in relationships and a turn of events, will Vionne prevent this life from being another tragedy?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Life Was but a Play

title.native: 瞳の中の僕を知らない
title.romaji: Hitomi no Naka no Boku wo Shiranai

189386.description:
"What should I do…? I think I’ve fallen for him…!!"

Kaoru, an honor student, is asked by his teacher to help tutor Shinta, a troubled student who rarely attends school. Reluctantly agreeing just to earn some extra credit, Kaoru expects resistance—but to his surprise, Shinta, despite his initial defiance, turns out to be unexpectedly obedient. And when praised, his reactions are adorably cute…!?

Unaccustomed to receiving compliments, Shinta even tries his best at the naughty challenges Kaoru jokingly teases him with.

Completely caught off guard by Shinta’s unexpected sweet side, Kaoru finds himself unable to stop his heart from racing—but what happens next…!?

(Source: KiR comics, translated)

title.native: 俺の可愛い、褒められたがりくん

189387.description:
Kento, a weary office worker, meets Sora, a construction worker, at a small candy shop. Sora’s friendly smile and comforting presence gradually soothe Kento, leading him to visit the shop more often and become increasingly aware of Sora. Then, one day, when Sora catches him just as he’s about to fall, the strength and warmth of his embrace unexpectedly send a reaction through Kento’s lower body…!?

A deeply sweet love story between a cheerful, muscular man and an exhausted salaryman!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: This Love is Surely Too Sweet

title.native: この恋はきっと、甘すぎる

189388.description:
“I have erectile dysfunction.”

Not exactly the kind of confession Woo Hyeon-Woo ever planned to make, but a few too many drinks later, his biggest secret slips out to his classmate Ha Jeong-Yoon. Mortified, Hyeon-Soo braces for pity or laughter… but Jeong-Yoon just grins.

“Then why don’t we test it out? Who knows? Maybe I can fix you.”

Wait, what?! Before Hyeon-Soo can process what’s happening, he’s suddenly part of Jeong-Yoon’s “scientific experiment.” What started as drunken honesty turns into a very hands-on test of chemistry, curiosity, and terrible decisions. Now, every accidental touch feels like a loaded dice roll. Will it be a total flop, or a nat 20? Caught between panic and possibility, Hyeon-Soo wonders if maybe, just maybe, his biggest problem wasn’t physical after all…

Because with Jeong-Yoon around, something else is definitely ""rising"" to the occasion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189389.description:
Back in high school, Hyeon Ji-Woo was the ace of the legendary Seongeon High baseball team—and secretly dating his younger teammate, Choi Seon-Ho. But their sweet first love came to an abrupt end when Seon-Ho suddenly left for the U.S., breaking up with Ji-Woo without warning. Fast forward 10 years: Ji-Woo has buried all his desires and emotions under a mountain of work, living a quiet, no-nonsense life… until Seon-Ho shows up again. Not as a successful returnee or old flame, but as a temp worker—causing a scene with a bottle of whiskey in hand! Cue the chaos: awkward reunions, unresolved tension, and one very confused adult trying not to fall all over again. He was Ji-Woo’s first love, first heartbreak… and possibly, his newest headache.

Is this a second chance at love—or just a second round of disaster?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.
synonyms: ゼロセンチメートル〜10年ぶりに再会した初恋のあいつ〜

189390.description:
From childhood, Sohm has always felt queasy and unsettled whenever he looks at Geon, a boy who is almost like him but somehow completely different. The two can never meet eyes without arguing, and when their parents remarry and they suddenly become family, strict rules are put in place to keep the peace. Rule One: Go to and from school together. Rule Two: Hug for thirty full seconds before entering the house. Forced into daily embraces, their unwanted closeness begins to change in ways neither expected. Geon’s teasing eventually leads to something far more risky than bickering, and the two find themselves sharing more than they had ever intended...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19

189391.description:
Viola, the daughter of a declining count (she was Japanese in her previous life), was married off to Albert―the next duke―by her parents. However, on the very first night of their marriage, her husband declares, “All I ask of you is that you carry out your role as the wife of the duke in appearance only,” effectively shattering any hope of a romantic relationship.

Despite the soul-destroying statement from him, Viola picks up the pieces and starts to live happily and without restraints, announcing, “Forget my ice-cold, rude husband. I'm gonna live my life the way I want!” However, her new husband and mansion seem to hide a secret...?! It's a smothering romance of a reincarnated, happy-go-lucky lady who, by comforting the traumatized husband, turns him into the most doting of husbands♡

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: My Ice-Rose Husband Said He Only Wants Me to Play the Role of the Next Duchess, but Now He's Stalking Me at Home!

A special collaboration between Satosumi Takaguchi, Miwa Sakai, and Emiko Yachi! (And special guests)
The year is 1962, world famous Hollywood actress M.M. has passed away, and its rumoured that her diary contained dirty secrets about very important politicians....

This special collaboration was planned and organized by Satosumi Takaguchi to commemorate Miwa Sakai going freelance, with all contributors drawing one "cast member" each

189394.description:

On a dark, quiet night, as Se-A returns to her empty home, flickering lights reveal a man in a cap standing at her doorstep. He calls her name, and when she turns, she’s stunned by the familiar face: someone she believed had died ten years ago. Letting him in sets off a chain of unraveling truths, buried secrets, and painful misunderstandings. But he’s not the only one hiding something. As past and present collide, can the two mend the distance that time and silence have carved between them?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

189675.description:
An island of gemstones and magical beasts floats in the sky...
On this island lives a kind and powerful demon king, Kougyoku.

Some forty years ago, Kougyoku used his magic to restore a stillborn griffin egg to life, and that griffin became his dearest companion, Topaz. In the years that followed, Topaz found that his love for Kougyoku had grown into something deeper than that of a beast's love for his king... and unbeknownst to him, Kougyoku had begun to feel the same.

Now, as Kougyoku struggles to summon the magic needed to restore his island, he is torn between his love for Topaz and his duty as king. And as his beloved finds himself faced with an impossible decision, Topaz is left with no choice but to decide their fates for him, even should it break his king's heart...!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

189679.description:
A man who has everything and yet nothing. The only thing successful corporate executive Jin-Hyeok Son ever really wanted was an ordinary life with a beloved family, a desire arising from the tragic death of his parents when he was a child. This all changes after he finds himself back in his nine-year-old body after an accident -- to a time when his parents are still alive, to the very life he had longed to return to! Can Jin-Hyeok change the past and finally fulfill his dream of an ordinary life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

189680.description:
After traveling back in time, Lia finds herself in the orphanage where she spent her childhood just before Diana, the lost daughter of Duke Ellad, arrives. Remembering with regret how she once ignored Diana's mistreatment in the orphanage, she vows to protect her until her family finds her. The two grow close, and she sees her life unfolding in an unexpected way as she is welcomed into House Ellad with Diana. Will Lia find happiness in her second life, surrounded by love she's never known?

(Source: Tapas)

189683.description:
Cordelia, daughter of a countess, can’t seem to get married–mostly because her little sister Priscilla keeps stealing the hearts of her suitors. Ready to resign herself to a spinster fate, Cordelia is surprised when a handsome man suddenly courts her–and he’s a prince, no less! Prince Leonhardt, who possesses the power of a legendary lion, is a widely admired man but has his own quirks, such as pursuing Cordelia because he was drawn to her scent. How cat-like is this man?! A fun (and feline) fantasy romance!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

189691.description:
What makes a 'proper adult'? Inspired by the words of his late father, Yutaro Urashima sought to become an upstanding member of society by developing and strictly adhering to his own "Articles of Adulthood." Little did he know, however, that those same articles would go on to dramatically change the world... A new series from the author of Hidarikiki no Eren! Witness the dramatic battle for survival in a surveillance society where reputation is everything!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189692.description:
The manga centers on Sugawara, an employee of a consultant firm, who is not exactly excited about the lectures he give to companies, and finds himself unresponsive in his work. After one night of heavy drinking, he gets kidnapped by an evil organization called the "Black Shock Gang," and he is given the mission to defeat heroes through an "organizational reform."

(Source: Anime News Network)

189694.description:
Lovebirds Ren and Shino have left their school days behind and set out into the world of working adults. Independence is exciting, but living on their own and starting their careers come with a whirlwind of challenges. Ren is struggling to make time in her busy modeling schedule for her girlfriend. Shino is happy about Ren’s success, but she can’t help but notice all the admiring gazes Ren attracts. Then when they’re finally alone, Shino shies from physical intimacy! And to top it all off, Shino gets along with her coworkers and students so well that it’s stoking Ren’s jealousy. Do these high school sweethearts have what it takes to clear these hurdles and build a future together?

(Source: Yen Press)
